reviews.title: Like a serviced apartment
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few weeks in November and really enjoyed it.  We were assigned to Building 9/"Iris" building with the "quiet pool."The room:The 1 BR looks exactly like photos--it was spacious, clean, and very functional for what we needed. The bed was a little creeky and lumpy but we slept ok. The kitchen had an oven and stovetop plus the cooking utensils we needed. It would have been helpful for them to have measuring spoons and salt/pepper, but we bought some during the trip. Having an in-room washer/dryer was really convenient, though we had to clean the washer and remove lint from previous guests. Wifi was strong - we had a router in our room. There is also a safe that fit our 2 laptops.A few watch-outs: the walls are thin. We heard our neighbors next door and above us throughout the stay. A/C worked really well until night time, when I think it shut down because of cooler outside temps, but we couldn't open the window so the room got hot.Inconsistent housekeeping was the other frustration. Apparently if you want housekeeping during the first week you have to pay for it(!) but thereafter, weekly housekeeping is included except you have to schedule it, none of which was told to us. When we got it scheduled, housekeeping was 30 minutes late and then rushed because we had to return to the room after an hour, and housekeeping forgot several items (washclothes, dishrag, detergent, sweeping the floors, etc). When we booked housekeeping after our second week, she arrived on time and did a great job cleaning. For our taste, weekly cleaning is too infrequent and likely causes more work for housekeeping in the long run. To that end, the hallways in our building didn't have the carpeting vacuumed enough--there was often visible dirt, crumbs and other detritus.The property:The fitness center, esp, the cardio room, is large and well maintained. The weight room, which had pulley weights, was clean and everything worked.  It was too chilly to try the pools but they looked clean and inviting: the staff did a great job maintaining the exterior of the property. When we were there, their arcade was closed for construction. In November, there is ample parking and security drives around regularly.  The resort is a good location for us as we split our time between the Strip and hiking.Check out is early - 10am, and the staff came at knocking 8:40!

reviews.title: Where Custom service goes to die...
reviews.text: ⭐️ 1-Star Review: If I could there would be a minus in front.My 65th Birthday Trip That Grandview Las Vegas Turned Into HeartbreakI’m writing this not out of anger, but out of deep disappointment — and a need to be heard.My three sons gifted me a stay at The Grandview Las Vegas Resort, November 9–14, 2025, to celebrate my 65th milestone birthday — a moment meant to honor faith, resilience, and a lifetime of overcoming.It was supposed to be a trip filled with joy and gratitude.Then the U.S. government shutdown happened — airports are closing, long delays and waits,  a situation no one could have predicted or controlled. My sons reached out to the resort with one simple, reasonable request: to reschedule my birthday trip for a later date. No refund, no special favors — just kindness and flexibility.Hey, so what We received a cold indifference.A robotic “actually we are going with our policy.”A dismissive “planes are still flying.”That was the response to a 65-year-old woman with arthritis, during a national crisis — from a company that claims to care about its guests.The Grandview Las Vegas didn’t show an ounce of empathy or understanding. They hid behind fine print instead of standing on compassion.This was supposed to be a once-in-a-lifetime celebration — my sons’ way of saying, “Mom, you deserve this.”Instead, it became a lesson in how corporate greed can eclipse basic human decency.To Grandview Las Vegas management:Luxury is not your marble floors or brand name.Luxury is how you treat people when life happens.You may have kept the money, but you lost something greater — integrity, trust, and respect.To every traveler reading this: when life throws a curveball, you’ll learn who truly values their guests.Sadly, Grandview Las Vegas made it clear — they don’t.#GrandviewLasVegas #65thBirthday #CustomerServiceFail #SeniorTraveler #LuxuryWithoutHeart #TimeshareTrouble #FaithAndResilience #DoBetterGrandview

reviews.title: Still love the Grandview but hoping for better next time
reviews.text: We love The Grandview — the rooms, pools, and resort amenities are always wonderful, which is why we were excited to come back. However, this stay got off to a really rough start.We arrived late on Saturday night with our children, only to be placed in a room that smelled absolutely terrible and was located next to the trash area. The odor was so strong it made us gag. We went straight back to the lobby, and thankfully they moved us to another two-bedroom unit.Unfortunately, when we finally got settled (around 10 p.m.), we discovered there were no sheets or bedding for the pullout couch in either room. After calling down, it took over an hour for housekeeping to bring them. Our kids were exhausted, and after a long day of traveling, that was the last thing we wanted to deal with.The next morning, the second bedroom had a heavy smoke odor. We requested an air treatment before my elderly parents arrived, but it took 36 hours and over 10 calls to get it handled. That kind of delay and lack of follow-through was really disappointing — we’ve never experienced anything like that before at a resort.Lastly, there are simply not enough luggage carts, which made unloading food, coolers, and bags very difficult (especially with kids). On top of that, only one of the two elevators was working during our entire stay, so everything took forever.Overall, we still love the Grandview’s atmosphere and amenities, but this experience was far from the smooth, relaxing vacation we expected. reviews.title: Don’t Recommend
reviews.text: Dear Grandview Las Vegas Management,I am writing to formally request a refund for one night of my recent stay due to a series of issues that made the experience extremely stressful for me and my three young children.I originally booked one night online for September 22, 2025. Upon check-in around 10 PM that evening, I asked to extend my stay to two nights. Instead of simply updating my reservation, I was told by the front desk that I had to book another night online. This was inconvenient and unusual, as most hotels are able to extend a stay directly with a credit card on file.The check-in process itself was slow and confusing, and the staff appeared inexperienced. After finally receiving my room assignment (Room 10–1104), I was not given directions. With three tired children late at night, I discovered that both the elevator and stairs were blocked off. Only after asking again was I told that our room was actually located in a different building, requiring us to walk outside to Building Four in the dark.The following morning, I was abruptly woken up by hotel staff saying I had to come down to the lobby to sign new paperwork for my second night—even though I had already paid online. Later, when I stepped out briefly, I returned to find that my room keys no longer worked. I was forced to walk in the heat with my children back to the main lobby (a 10-minute walk), wait in a long line, and re-sign paperwork just to regain access to the room I had already booked and paid for.This entire experience was chaotic, mismanaged, and unnecessarily difficult. Between the unclear booking process, lack of communication, repeated disruptions, and issues with room access, my stay was far from acceptable.Given the circumstances, I respectfully request a refund for one of my night stay as compensation for the poor service and the undue stress caused.I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and look forward to your response.Sincerely,Anh Lilly 626 485 7144

reviews.title: I must've had bad luck with this stay
reviews.text: I initially booked the stay in Expedia and it started off great with check-in at the main building being painless and quick while being assigned a one bedroom suite on the first floor of the tower closest to the entrance and across the street from South Point’s south entrance, an assignment that I’m grateful for as the layout can be daunting especially if inebriated (as what occurred with a poor fellow guest who I encountered in the evening!) It’s once I settled into the night that the cracks started showing.It started out with noticing that the bathroom had an accessible shower but the handle to hold the handheld shower head was broken and resting on the handlebar which meant for complicated showers. At around midnight the bedroom’s smoke detector gave off the cursed beep signaling a dying backup battery. Not wanting to wait for maintenance to come over I detach the unit and remove the battery while making a note to inform the front desk in the morning. Then at around two in the morning it sounded like the jacuzzi in the room above mine was on full blast which unfortunately could be heard downstairs.I’d honestly try this place again if the circumstances allow as everything else seemed fine. The room was otherwise kept and clean, the staff whom I interacted with, including Itzel in the front desk, were fantastic to work with and are probably the saviors that cushioned the blow of this stay being a complete dud. I was bracing for any timeshare sales talk or reps to approach me but that didn’t happen either (probably because I didn’t submit that raffle drawing ticket that came with the room key) which I was grateful for. All in all I really just want to chalk this stay up random chance giving me the short straw.

We can’t wait to come again…just not to the Iris Building (aka the senior home).

reviews.title: A perfect stay for comfort and conveneince
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our time at The Grandview Las Vegas. The two-bedroom suite was incredibly spacious—plenty of room to relax, spread out, and feel at home. The kitchen was a standout feature: fully equipped, clean, and perfect for cooking meals when we wanted a break from dining out. Having a washer/dryer and whirlpool tub added even more comfort to the experience.The resort itself is well-maintained and offers great amenities like pools, hot tubs, and a game room. It’s close enough to the Strip for easy access, but far enough to enjoy some peace and quiet. Highly recommend for families or anyone looking for a roomy, well-appointed stay in Vegas!

reviews.title: Cozy Place To Stay
reviews.text: Love this place. Very clean almost to perfection. Good value for money if you don't mind it's a little off the strip. Extremely friendly staff who checked us in.

reviews.title: Dont Buy here
reviews.text: Place is getting old. It was just bought out in 2025 by new ownership and it is really going downhill fast. I have been an owner at the Grandview for 18 years and have used it several times a year for the last two decades.  The three times that I have used the Grandview this year have all been very disappointing as an owner.   I would not advise anyone to purchase the timeshare at this location unless they turn things back around for owners. If you are using it with booking.com or some other website booking it is adequate if it is convenient for you.   Service was poor, staff are not courteous or helpful, and the place is really getting run down..

reviews.title: Spacious
reviews.text: Great place—perfect for escaping the busy Las Vegas Strip. Love to walk to the Southpoint Casino to play!

reviews.title: Overcrowded and chaotic
reviews.text: We checked in on SAT, JUL 26. I've been going to Grandview for over 10 years and this was the most crowded I've ever seen. The line to check in was out of the door. Parking was nearly impossible -- there were dozens of cars circling the lot looking for open spots. I had reserved 2 2-bedroom units. They  had one ready and said we would have to wait a while for the other. OK, that's fine. Checkin is at 4 PM. We waited and waited and waited...I called them from my room probably 10 times. Each time they said the same thing -- the room is ready and we'll bring the keys to you. Finally, at 7:30 PM they did it. We were exhausted from waiting all day to get in both of our rooms. Basically, we lost the first day of our vaca.  Then, they wanted to charge a $56 resort fee -- FOR EACH ROOM!!!I don't believe it is legal to charge resort fees for owners (like myself). Very, very disappointed.

reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: When arriving, there was 2 long lines, one moved and the other didnt. There was no organization on how the next guest was being helped. If you picked the wrong line then you had to wait longer. The room itself was not very clean. Smelled like smoke, the phone didnt work, the tub was dirty, and there were ants on the night stand.

reviews.title: Kitchen missing.a lot of utensils
reviews.text: Shuttle bus for groceries is good.its better if you have shuttle bus going to the strip…and premium factory outlet…

reviews.title: Not Like it Used to Be
reviews.text: This has been my favorite resort in Vegas for many years. I’ve encouraged friends and family to travel there. This time we were met with terribly uncomfortable beds, a c not working correctly, phone not working, toilet running constantly, and unfriendly unhelpful front desk staff. I’m not sure if it is still considered a gold crown resort but I certainly don’t think it meets those standards anymore.

reviews.title: don't stay at the Grandview in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We bought a timeshare in 2023 by being promised so many amenities and ability to use it. But we haven't been able to get any benefit from it. We decided to try to see what the accomodations at the Grandview are like this summer. So we visited. But we paid $432 for two nights at a run down poorly maintained low class building. Do not buy from these guys. They tried to make us pay more to upgrade our poor quailty timeshare product to the 'new' offering!!! Imagine: we can't use what we have at all and then we should pay more in order to get some value? They should have upgraded our '1 week' timeshare to their new points system FOR FREE. You have no idea how angry I am.

reviews.title: Grandview timeshare
reviews.text: Rooms are big and clean. Have everything you need for long stay. Pools are great for family lots to offer at resort. Only complaint is the bed wasn’t great and hurt my back as well as wife’s back after a while.

reviews.title: The Grandview Resort is a dump.
reviews.text: My husband and I contracted contact dermatitis from dust mites at the Grandview resort in June. It is now August (tomorrow), and I have yet to receive ANY compensation. It took weeks to get a reply about anything. As much as we like The Berkely as a FAMILY. We have decided to no longer spend our money with the company AT ALL. We have a very large family, half of which live in Vegas. This could have all been settled easily, yet I have been given nothing but the run around. The Grandview Resort is Trash. Save your money and go literally anywhere else.

reviews.title: Family friendly
reviews.text: Great for a family vacation. Not in the busy las vegas strip area. But has the casino across the street.  Lots for the family to do on property.

reviews.title: Loved the 2 Bedroom Unit
reviews.text: We went to Las Vegas with another couple/family. It was nice having the two bedroom unit because we had our privacy and they had theirs. It was great being able to buy groceries for cooking, and being able to store them in the full size refrigerator. The multiple pools on the premises made it a fun experience because we alternated. There was a very nice kid friendly pool for our friends’ kids. The gym was nice, but small.

reviews.title: Family Resort
reviews.text: Great place to stay and enjoy your time with your family. Definitely we will come back soon and enjoy all the amenities they offer.

reviews.title: Worst Hotel Experience
reviews.text: Im not typically a "reviewer," but this was just the worst experience. I traveled with my husband and 4 kids (12, 11, and 2 year old twins). On arrival, the bathroom floor had blood and the shower had mold in all the crevices. Called for housekeeping..never came...so I had to go buy bleach and bleach the entire bathroom and other hard surfaces. Then it was time for bed. The sofa bed had no linens or pillows in the room so I had to call for those (at 10pm)...3 calls and multiple hours later (around 1am) they finally got delivered (although no pillows).  2nd day, went to guest services for towels, laundry soap and to request 2 cribs for the twins. I was told it would be easier if I just called to request them, so I did. Again...never got delivered.  There's a game room, but you have to go to the concierge to request any supplies for ping pong, Pool, or mini golf. We went around 3pm and there was a sign that they would be back at 8pm. We stay in hotels pretty frequently for travel sports (about once or twice a month) and this was by far the worst hotel experience we've ever had.

reviews.title: horrible. no linens no toiletries and mgmt doesnt care
reviews.text: Do NOT stay here. the service and staff are pitiful. we arrived at 1am and had no sheets or pillows in our room. we had been up for 20 hours travelling and had to sleep with bath towels on the mattress because housekeeping only had one runner and we didn't get sheets until after 5am. nobody cared. we spoke to the "manager" at the front desk who had no power and didnt care and we were told we had to deal with the third party we booked with. when i called that number they said nope a quality issue is for the hotel to handle. went back to mgmt and they didnt care at all. the room was dirty outdated and the whole building smells.

reviews.title: Comfortable, but average
reviews.text: We went for a back to school shopping trip. We like that the location is away from the strip. The pools were overcrowded though and so we didn't get to enjoy swimming. The rooms were mostly clean, just some dust bunnies in the corners. Beds were comfortable. We enjoyed being able to spread out and have space. The check-in process needs some help and there is always a wait at the elevators.

reviews.title: The Grandview hotel was a nice little retreat for our family. The resort had a lot to offer!
reviews.text: Our stay at The Grandview in Las Vegas was a nice little retreat for our family. The resort had a lot to offer and made it easy for all of us to relax and have fun. We especially enjoyed the putt-putt course, the nearby golf, and of course, the pools—perfect for cooling off and spending time together. It was a refreshing break from the hustle of the Strip, and we’d definitely come back!

reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.text: Spent a week with my family. We had a great time. We had close access to SouthPoint to enjoy all the amenities. The staff at The Grandview were awesome. Very convenient transportation to and from hotel. Also provided trips to local Walmart. Convenience of room service from local pizza or groceries. We will definitely be visiting again.

reviews.title: Disappointed Stay
reviews.text: The shower and bathroom sinks would not drain, so I had to wait for maintenance to come.  The coffee machine and front burner of the stove were broke, so I had to wait for new coffee machine.  There were no parking spaces at night to park the car, if you came back after 10 pm good luck! There is no security, anyone can come on to the complex, no security coming on to property, no security in the building, anyone can come into the building. groups of kids hanging around outside. Felt unsafe walking around.

reviews.title: Guest has to do their job to deleted prior phone messages! $20 to hold you hostage!
reviews.text: Vacation  |  FamilyNo service worth to mention at all. The room’s phone has multiple undeleted/unlistened voice messages dating back all the way to before the 4th of July, which cost us over 5-7 minutes to delete since none of the messages could be deleted until you had to listen through each of them till its end. Without deleting those, the phone’s red light kept flashing that bothers us quite a bit. Never have we seen a hotel room being kept so sloppy. We were asked to sign up for a timeshare session at the time of checkin with a $20 deposit but when we asked to cancel the session the night before, they didn’t want to return the $20! Alas! $20, to hold us hostage so that we had to come back to their time share pitch another time. What a way to do business! The facility is more than 8 miles away from the Strip and quite some drive from good dining places, therefore is really not a good place to stay if you want to feel the vibe of the city. For the money, there are plenty places around to stay. Rooms: 2/5  |  Service: 1/5  |  Location: 1/5

reviews.title: July 2025 review
reviews.text: Fair resort over all. Casino next door offers convince, security and maintenance could use some updates but Good. Older buildings but clean.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Loved the rooms they were very spacious and had all the amenities you needed. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Stay at Grandview
reviews.text: Overall our stay was great! Had a few small bumps but we would stay here again. The location was clean and the timeshare staff was great. We did purchase another timeshare while there to add onto our current one.

reviews.title: Just the best place to stay for a family
reviews.text: WE have been coming here for 8 years now and as a family we just love it here. Some much to do for every one.

reviews.title: The unit we were in needed updating. The couch was old and worn. The floor was dirty.
reviews.text: The unit we were in needed updating. The couch was old and worn. The floors needed to be cleaned and mopped. Something sticky was all over the kitchen floor. Stove was also in needed of replacement. Appliance different colors. Some white some stainless steel. I was not impressed.

reviews.title: Stay at Grandview
reviews.text: Enjoy our family vacation.  We were close to the strip without staying st the strip.  Enjoy being walking distance to the South Point.  Eating places were close also.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Arrived Wednesday afternoon around 4pm and Unit A had a really smell I contacted to let them know advise he would put it on record so we won’t get charged. Unit B was dirty. The floor was not swept and appliances were really greasy. I contacted Guest Services requested the following items toilet paper , bath towels and bedding linen sets for both sofa bed. I was told a ticket was submitted and the items should be at the door shortly. We received them our items at 12:30am which was 8 hours after my first call!

reviews.title: Terrible stay!
reviews.text: In building 6 the elevators were down all weekend. There was one working elevator and there were tons of people! Wait time was excessive up to 30 mins. We were on the 19th floor so the stairs were out! It was just a bad experience overall and staff could care less!

reviews.title: Amazing place to stay
reviews.text: Very safe and clean. I love my overall stay at Grandview. I was able to take a good rest  and loving all the amenities. I will definitely book here again.

reviews.title: Nice little hideaway
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. It's away from all the traffic of the strip, but not too far to visit. The staff was friendly and the room was nice I enjoyed having the kitchen stocked with the appropriate dishware & cookware.

reviews.title: Grandview
reviews.text: Overall great stay parking is bad at night and long  wait for staff tv outdated . Great pools clean room great air condition

reviews.title: Stayed here numerous times
reviews.text: This place is located on the south end of Las Vegas Blvd. The property is always clean, well lit at night & safe. The rooms are the size of a small apartment with all the furnishings. The bath tub is very nice & large. It is located in the room. The shower is separate & located in the bathroom. The living room area is a nice size with a recliner & sofa. The furniture & the bed are very comfortable. I have stayed at this property multiple times and it never disappoints.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Location is key for us. Love that it is right across the street from Southpoint. Love the number of pools that are available.

reviews.title: R & R
reviews.text: Great place to stay for your vacation if you still want some of the comforts of being at home. South Point Casino is next door. Walking distance for some of us. Plenty to do there as well. The Grandview is well maintained and clean. Plus, it feels safe here. Also, kid friendly, and enough parking.

reviews.title: Always a good choice
reviews.text: Me and my family had a great time as usual,but a couple of hiccups.we checked in on July 4th so was busier than normal.the check in agent (“Randy”new guy)was really rude and rolled his eyes at me because I stated that I put a request in for a specific building that according to him wasn’t available.i guess he was having a bad day but ok we got to the room and the floor wasn’t swept or mopped properly.there were eye lashes and crumbs on the floor in the kitchen living room and bedroom,house keeping was next door cleaning a room so a was able to get a vacuum and clean up what ever I saw but I never been thru that b4 so I’m going to chalk it up to them not having enough workers during a extremely busy holiday weekend.beside that everything was good. I was told by reception that they were bought out by new owners so let’s see if they do as good of a job that the previous owners did.

reviews.title: A great option for larger groups away from the crowded strip!
reviews.text: We had a party of 5 that easily fit into our clean and modern suite. Parking was easy and the staff was great!

reviews.title: Nice place to stay, close to Southpoint casino resort
reviews.text: Quick check in, room was clean. Staff was helpful and friendly. Located next to The Southpoint Casino resort, with 12 movie theaters, bowling, restaurants, Buffet (which is a great value), less expensive gaming tables than the strip.

reviews.title: Home away from Home
reviews.text: I am a owner at Grandview and anyone who frequents Las Vegas more than a few times a year should consider purchasing their units. For me, it is a home away from home. The rooms are spacious and perfect when  traveling with young family members. I especially appreciate that there's a full kitchen with basic kitchen supplies to prepare meals in the room ,which I prefer rather than  eating out at restaurants several times a day when traveling with a family. Conversely if you travel with a lot of luggage be prepared to handle it yourself because the property does not offer bellman services. Also, the place is a few miles away from the strip but theres a casino next door. The Grandview is not walking distance from the Vegas lights but everything you might need is nearby.

reviews.title: Grandview, you can do better!
reviews.text: The toilet and shower were dirty with sludge. I called the front desk to request cleaning and was told it could be several hours before it was cleaned. I had to request expedited service as my family couldn’t wait that long for a toilet. The toilet did not flush well. The carpet odor was horrible. The room paint, wall and ceilings are outdated! The smoke detector had not been changed in what looked the be twenty years. The room was not dusted. Dust was hanging from all of the vents. It was obvious that it was months since the last dusting. The mattress was uncomfortable. There was no sheer curtain under the blackout curtain. I requested a sheer because the sun was very bright and blinding when opening the blackout curtain. I spoke with William who was rude and non- resolving. It took and extensive conversation to get the sheer. I was initially told that the property does not provide this anymore. When asked if I could have a room that still had a sheer curtain I was told no because there were other customers and I could not inconvenience them, and there was no guarantee that another room would have the curtain. When I asked to speak with someone else William repeatedly stated no, and that he was the only person that I could speak to. After refusing to accept that response he sent someone to hang the curtain. It took nearly 30 mins of back and forth to get it resolved. Housekeeping is nonexistent until checkout day. Check out time is 10am. They arrived at 8am before we checked out to clean the room. Other wise, there was never any service. The kids pool area was nice. We choose the property because of the kitchen , washer and dryer. The appliances worked well. The timeshare presentation trap was a horrible experience. It was described as a quick “walk through tour of new property”. I should have followed my intuition and declined, but was having an open mind. Our day after arrival was hijacked by this presentation. When we declined to purchase and decided to leave after a few hours the representative became upset and was using tactics to attempt to detain us. Our time was hijacked. The tour was a unit that was exactly the same as ours! Sitting through that presentation was like sitting through another marketing scheme. Overall families can benefit from access to cooking and doing laundry, but the units are dated and need renovation and the cleanliness needs improved.

reviews.title: Just average

reviews.title: 4th of July at Grandview
reviews.text: Great time this year at Grandview and looking forward to next year going to the pool and going to South Point casino.

reviews.title: The best value in all of Las Vegas!

reviews.text: I came out to Vegas for the Fourth of July to meet up with family and friends to celebrate the Fourth of July weekend and had fun it was nice staying at the Grandview again

reviews.title: Good price but cleanliness was seriously lacking
reviews.text: The proximity to Southpoint Hotel was wonderful and made it convenient. The rooms were large and the bed was comfortable. The price was very affordable. The room was very dirty though. We found a dirty pair of men’s underwear in the corner of the room under a bench, and an open condom wrapper on the edge of the jacuzzi tub. The dust was very thick as though it only receives surface cleaning. It appears this is the standard because the dust was so thick, many different housekeepers would have had to ignore it over time for it to build up that much. reviews.text: Great location.  Not directly on the strip, yet just next door to South Pointe casino and resort.  Friendly staff, great units.  Perfect for a family vacation or couples get away.  Even have a "mostly adult" pool.

reviews.title: Property Owner Grandview
reviews.text: Front Desk Check -In Horrible - Four Hours after Check-In Housekeeping walked into our room- Second Day- Maintenance was drilling into ceiling drywall at 620am.  Room needs desperate deep cleaned/ hallways and elevator filthy

reviews.title: The worst resort experience we’ve ever had.
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at The Grandview from June 20th to 23rd, and to say we were disappointed is an understatement. We booked this resort primarily for the advertised five pools and the in-room jet tub. Unfortunately, both were major letdowns, along with the overall cleanliness and management’s complete lack of accountability.The Pools & Common Areas:The pools and hot tubs were overcrowded with unsupervised children constantly turning the jets on and off. Meanwhile, parents blasted their own music through portable speakers, making it impossible to relax.The Room:Our room was far from clean. There were crumbs on the carpet, children’s fingerprints smeared across the TV, and some kind of unknown liquid spilled on the bedroom curtains. The floors looked like they hadn’t been properly cleaned in ages. The in-room jet tub was unusable — as soon as I turned it on, black mold spewed out from the jets. Obviously, I didn’t use it after that.Later that night around 12:30am, I found a bug in the bed. Whether it was a bed bug or a carpet beetle, a bug in your bed is unacceptable. Upon further inspection, we found two more bugs. We immediately called the front desk, only to be put on hold forever, which seems to be standard practice here. Eventually, a security guard arrived with keys to a new room — meaning we had to pack up everything and move rooms at nearly 1am, ruining our first night entirely.Second Room — Same Story:We thoroughly checked the second room before settling in, only to find visible black mold already growing on the jets of this tub — no need to even turn it on. The shower had black mold, yellow stains, and someone else’s hair in it before we had even touched it. The sheets had old blood stains on them. Light switches were covered in grime, dirt, and dust. I couldn’t walk barefoot in the room because of how dirty it felt.Management:We spoke to a manager at checkout on the 23rd. He acknowledged the bed bug complaint, saw our photos and videos, and admitted this was “unacceptable” and that “something would be done” and we’d “be compensated.” We were promised a follow-up later that day — no one called.We had to chase them down repeatedly. When we finally got through on the 24th, another manager confirmed they tested for bed bugs, and while they “couldn’t identify the bugs,” they only test for bed bugs — so unexplained bugs in the bed are apparently acceptable at The Grandview.We also brought up the mold, the uncleanliness, and the major inconvenience of moving rooms at 1am due to their negligence. The manager told us we might get compensation but only after she emailed the general manager, who is “only reachable by email.” Two days passed — no response. We called again on June 27th, only to be told the general manager wasn’t available and they didn’t know when he would be.Conflicting stories, poor communication, and no accountability from management whatsoever. It’s now been nearly two weeks and we’ve heard nothing back.Bottom Line:We gave The Grandview every opportunity to make this right, but they’ve failed us at every turn. Between the bugs, the mold, the filth, the lack of professionalism, and the total disregard from management, this was one of the worst resort stays we’ve ever experienced.SAVE YOUR MONEY. STAY SOMEWHERE ELSE. Do NOT stay at The Grandview at Las Vegas.

reviews.text: The hotel is great! It is so close to the strip but much more peaceful and so nice to have a kitchen. With some minor changes to the gym, it would be perfect. reviews.title: Maintenance
reviews.text: Some small maintenance problems on the kitchen ware and the bathroom. That has never happened in the stays we had here.

reviews.title: Not so Grand
reviews.text: The rooms were lovely, very clean, and roomy. Pools were very nice and the property had parking pretty near to the building. This resort is focused on a timeshare business, and it's clear that when you're a guest who doesn't participate in timeshares or anything to do with them, that you're not as important. My daughter was sick so we needed to stay a third night after having stayed for two nights. I understand that there's a two-night policy, especially during the summer season. I wanted to stay for a third night and the manager refused to allow it. He said I needed to stay two more nights, and that he could override it but that he wouldn't. He didn't care at all the reason. I also needed to get back to work and was driving a long way to get back. I wasn't going to make my daughter travel when she was sick. I was forced to stay two more nights, or just leave and lose the money for the fourth night. Also, if you want a second package of coffee, they charge you for it. I mentioned that other hotels will give you things like shampoo, coffee, and soap when out, and he said they were a timeshare and not a hotel. reviews.title: Great resort

Its near plenty of restaurants, grocery strores , and anything you may need. Would absolutely comeback and recommend to family and friends

reviews.title: Great couples getaway/stay cation.
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to take advantage of the great price we found  for one of the larger rooms at Grandview and it was a great decision in retrospect. The staff was great, the room large, clean, and stocked with everything you might need for a few days away from home. From laundry detergent for the washer and dryer in the room to dishwasher pods for doing dishes. The unit had everything I could think of and more. Having the ability to go see the city in this heat and come back and wash all your things was a huge selling point for me. Free TV and internet didnt hurt either. I would recommend anyone looking for a quality place to stay that wont break the bank to give this place a try. You wont be disappointed

reviews.title: Great family stay at Grandview!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Grandview. It’s a great place to stay with kids — very family-friendly and peaceful. The location is perfect: close enough to the Strip to enjoy the attractions, but far enough to relax and unwind. There’s a casino right next door if you’re looking for some entertainment without going too far.The pool area was a real highlight — clean, spacious, and perfect for children to have fun. We really appreciated the calm and safe environment. We would definitely come back for another stay!

reviews.title: Perfect place for group or family gathering

reviews.title: Horrible management
reviews.text: Two hour check in time on June 6, 2025. Rooms were not clean and shower doors would not close. Floors were very dirty and dusty. Room keys didn't work after two days. Reported to William Mora (manager) and no importance was taken. His response was to email him with details. Very dissapointed with new management team.

reviews.title: LOVED OUR STAY HERE!
reviews.text: 20 mins from strip but good parking and nice, big rooms! We were impressed they allowed us to check in early too! Thanks guys!

reviews.title: Family getaway

reviews.title: Great family resort!
reviews.text: We always have a good stay at the Grandview. The location is great if you want off the strip but close enough to enjoy a show for the evening and then come back to a relaxed, family location. It's nice being next to SouthPoint casino so you can walk over and enjoy a movie, bowling, food and/or games. The pools are great with plenty of seating area's and several grills with picnic tables for cook outs. We also enjoyed a game of putt putt on the grounds and ate at the snack bar while at the pool.

reviews.title: Really nice lodging
reviews.text: Stayed at Grandview for a bowling tournament at Southpoint.  Grandview was really nice about accommodating an early check-in due to our flights, and let us store luggage after check-out until our next flight.  Wonderful service and really nice accommodations.

reviews.title: Below average for a Time Share-Disappointed
reviews.text: The resort is easily accessible to the strip with just a 10 minute drive. Staff were friendly but the room was not clean nor was our kitchen supplied with the essential kitchen silverware, pans or baking dishes. The garbage disposal was broke. Housekeeping did come up right away and brought the needed supplies and the plumber came and fixed our Disposal.  Also the sheet set for the pull out couch was dirty but they brought us a new set. The room was not cleaned well and the not maintained. The vents were coated with dust, the curtain shades were also coated with dust and the room was not vacuumed. My son's bathroom tub was filthy. Our granddaughter has Asthma and started having trouble breathing in the room. I contacted William the manager at check in and informed him of the need to have the room cleaned. He said he would have housekeeping come up right away, but they never came to clean the dust. He did credit us our resort fee. I then sent an email to his manager to discuss the situation but he never answered the email nor did he call me. The resort is average at best. The pools were dirty and the water/soda machines at the pool did not work. I was not happy with this stay.

reviews.title: Good value, lacks cleanliness

reviews.title: Disappointed and we won’t be back
reviews.text: We stayed here several years ago and I don’t recall the condition of the hotel to have been as bad as it is now. We checked in a day early for our two week visit so had to combine transactions and as a result,  had to move rooms because our floor was scheduled to be painted!!! Why weren’t we given a room that was available for the whole stay???!!! In the process of moving, we left behind a large plastic bag full of snacks for 2 weeks, including several pounds of beef jerky and chips. When we discovered the error, we asked to get access to our original room, but of course,  all the items left were removed and not returned by housekeepers! We stayed at IRIS this time because of the “quiet pool” which is certainly anything BUT that— full of kids and families. We had experienced A-LOT of marijuana through out the building but particularly in our first room due to a smoker in the adjacent suite. Nothing seems very clean inside and in the two rooms we stayed in,  and the decor is very outdated and the kitchen is set up with the bare minimum. We did enjoy having access to a bbq,  but only one side of the grill would light— another 50% positivity on that amenity!

reviews.title: Labor Day Weekend in Las Vegas
reviews.text: RCI was able to provide a week for my daughter & my grandchilden from Utah to meet me in Las Vegas at the Grandview Resort.  Eveyone had a great time.Only comment would be that USB charging stations are missing from the rooms - need an upgrade in this area.

reviews.title: Mini vacay!!!
reviews.text: Always look forward to our owners week at the Grandview. Rooms are always immaculate. Love the small add-ons to the room (dish liquid, laundry detergent, paper towels, etc.).

reviews.title: Good, but needs improvement!
reviews.text: We stayed here two separate weeks. The 1st week, the resort was nice. The views from the honeysuckle building were great. But, make sure you don't wait to check in. We checked in around 6:00 p.m. and had to wait an hour in a line of people.The 2nd week, we checked in at 3pm and everything went very smoothly. We stayed in the honeysuckle building again, which continued to have great views; however, this unit was dirtier than the first weeks unit. The second week in a different room was full of problems. There was other people's hair on the floor in almost every corner of the room and shelves. There was even more hair in the showers and tubs of the private parts and head hair. Upon putting our things on the counter, we found that the counters were dirty and still have food particles on them. Therefore the counters were never cleaned. My wife and I ended up cleaning the entire unit. The dishwasher also had a footprint of a shoe on the inside of the door. We washed and cleaned the dishwasher several times due to this, wasting our own dishwashing detergent. Upon examining the dryer we found a lot of filth and three handfuls of lint came out of the dryer. We reported this and the resort did send housekeeping to clean the tub and shower. The kind man even took pictures of the hairs and lint and other things in the unit.The next morning we woke up to the bathroom smelling like marijuana. We spoke with Daisy the manager.  They did send janitorial stuff member named Jewel to spray some spray, alerted security, and sent maintenance to examine the exhaust fan.

reviews.title: wouldn’t recommend
reviews.text: I would not recommend staying here for your trip. Check-in was complete chaos and extremely unorganized—it took forever to get checked in and make it to my room. Then they offered me a 90-minute tour with the promise of a $220 Visa gift card afterward. What they didn’t tell me was that the tour would turn into a 4.5-hour sales pitch for a timeshare. I was extremely annoyed, as it ended up wasting my entire day before the concert I had planned that night.

reviews.title: Complete Resort
reviews.text: The Grand View at Las Vargas is an excellent facility. The location (off The Strip) provides quiet atmosphere but close enough to the fun. The rooms (suites) are spacious, clean and comes complete with furnished kitchen. The his and hers bathroom sinks is nice. The huge bathtub, separate from the shower is a plus. The bed is comfortable that affords good night’ssleep. The swimming pool and BBQ grille and picnic areas are great! In short, The Grand View at LAs Vegas is a complete resort!

reviews.title: Disappointing Management During Peak Check-In
reviews.text: Stayed during a busy weekend and was shocked to see over 50 people waiting in line to check in—with no communication or support from the General Manager, who was hiding in his office the entire time. Front desk staff did their best, but leadership was clearly lacking when it was needed most. A disappointing experience that could have been improved with visible, proactive management.

reviews.title: Cleanliness Concerns
reviews.text: We were somewhat disappointed with the Grandview this trip.  The first unit we were assigned had multiple issues: missing pots and pans, floors were dirty, kitchen was disgraceful, windows were filthy, bathroom sinks held water, bedroom smelled like smoke, bedroom drawers wouldn’t stay closed and red stains in the carpet.  The property maintenance has not kept up with the aging property.  Be careful if you stay here and check your room thoroughly up arrival.  The staff were accommodating in assigning us another room, but management needs to do better with cleanliness of all units.  Over 20 years of traveling to Las Vegas and typically staying at the Grandview,  this is the first time we have ever encountered this situation.  It’s a beautiful property if well maintained.

reviews.title: Housekeeping
reviews.text: I’ve stayed here before and each time it seems to get worse it doesn’t take much to clean the unit but the bathroom shower shouldn’t have other people’s hair in it when you get ready to take your shower they aren’t even picking up trash inside the unit and the hallway either somebody needs to spot check the rooms after the so called cleaning it’s just not sanitary especially for people with medical conditions like myself

reviews.title: Birthday Get-A-Way!

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text: Been going here for 18 years.  Staff is inconsiderate.  They all ran away from the counter when I tried to check in.  When I wouldn't participate in the tineshare program, the employee tossed my parking pass at me. I caught it before it got the floor. If it wasn't 1am, there might have been issues.  I was tired.My building stayed open 24/7.. always has. The others don't. Furniture is old and dated.  Kitchens are worn out. If I smelled weed in the elevator ,hallways or pool one more time, I was leaving. Just a poorly run ship.Allowing non members to use timeshares. Loud music at the 'quiet pool'. reviews.title: Stole my money and cancelled my reservation
reviews.text: Due to a flight delay, I contacted the hotel on May 15th to inform them that my check-in would be delayed by one day. I spoke to a front desk employee who assured me that there would be no problem with my late check-in. I specifically asked if I could check in a day later and was told that it would not be an issue, as the hotel operates 24 hours. I received no indication that my reservation would be affected.However, upon arriving in Las Vegas on May 16th, I received an email stating that my reservation had been canceled. I immediately called the Grandview Hotel and was told by another employee that they had given my room away because I failed to check in on the original date. I explained that I had called in advance to notify them of my late arrival and was assured there would be no problem. Despite this, I was told there were no rooms available and no refund would be issued.When I asked for clarification, the employee asked if I had the name of the front desk staff member I spoke to, and I explained that I had not taken down her name. The employee then implied that it was my fault for not getting her name and insisted they could not assist further. I was informed that there were no available rooms and no refund would be provided.I then contacted the travel agency through which I booked the reservation (Expedia), and they filed a claim on my behalf. However, the Grandview Hotel was unreachable for several days. When they finally responded, they refused to issue any refund, citing that I did not check in on the scheduled date.I am extremely dissatisfied with the handling of my reservation and the refusal to issue a refund despite following proper channels to notify the hotel of my delayed arrival.

reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.text: The service was terrible!  We tried to call several times, housekeeping, maintenance, front desk and they all went to a busy signal.  Our toilet backed up, after sitting on hold waiting for the operator for 15 minutes she finally answered.  It took several calls finally after an hour someone came up and fixed the toilet.  My wife had to walk two buildings away just to use the bathroom.  Any time of day all lines are busy, you have to walk to the front of the resort to ask a question.  This resort use to be wonderful but we will never stay here again.  In fact we are thinking about leaving early.

reviews.text: We booked thru RCIWe have stayed here for the last 3 years attending the Holley LS Fest. We have a small car trailer that only needs to be parked one night at the resort. reviews.title: Disappointment Experience
reviews.text: I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with my recent stay at your resort, specifically in Building 9. While my initial check-in experience was positive, the subsequent issues rendered my vacation unacceptable.My family and I have been loyal guests to your resort in the past due to its convenient location. However, this visit dramatically altered our perception. The room assigned to us was in dire need of maintenance and cleanliness. Beyond the general dirt and disrepair, we discovered dried blood on both the door and the floor. This presented a significant biohazard and a serious health concern.Upon reporting this to the front desk, I was met with an unacceptable response. The staff member attempted to shift the blame onto us for reporting the issue after a few hours, despite having checked in early with their permission to drop off our belongings and go grocery shopping as the unit had a kitchen. Despite explaining the biohazard risk and the need for a thorough sanitation of the unit, a satisfactory resolution was not offered promptly. I only received a room change after presenting photographic evidence of the blood.The replacement room, located on the first floor near the smokers' area and laundry room, was equally unsatisfactory. It was also unclean and lacked essential kitchen supplies such as pots and pans. The entire situation was incredibly stressful and overshadowed what should have been a relaxing vacation.Considering the significant fees I paid – an exchange fee of over $200, plus a security deposit and resort fees – along with the use of my timeshare points, the quality of accommodation was simply unacceptable. The lack of a sincere apology or any attempt at genuine customer service is profoundly disappointing.I request a full review of this situation and a commensurate resolution to compensate for the significant inconvenience and distress caused. I expect a more proactive and empathetic response from your team regarding future bookings.PS i waited 7 days for a  manager to contact me and nothing yet. I was told someome would contact me but i got the run arounds

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem Near the Strip That Truly Feels Like Home
reviews.text: If you're looking for a peaceful Las Vegas stay without sacrificing access to the city's iconic nightlife, The Grand View is the perfect balance. Located just far enough from the Strip to enjoy restful nights, yet close enough for a quick ride into the heart of Vegas, this resort delivers the best of both worlds.What sets The Grand View apart is the genuine hospitality—every staff member goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome. From check-in to check-out, the attention to detail and kindness of the team create a home-like atmosphere that's rare to find.The accommodations are spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed like private apartments, ideal for relaxing after a night out or a day exploring. And as a major bonus, the resort is right next to South Point Casino, which offers more than just gaming—it’s home to one of the best buffets in town, a top-tier entertainment center, a rodeo arena, and so much more.Whether you’re in Vegas for fun, shows, food, or just a quiet escape, The Grand View is an unbeatable choice. reviews.title: A bit disappointing
reviews.text: Having stayed at a couple other Vacation Village properties and being an owner at one, I expected more.  Upon arriving at our room, the room was very stuffy.  Almost like there had been smokers in there and they attempted to get rid of the smoke smell.  I stayed in the A unit.  The sofa was missing a back cushion so I reported it because I didn't want them charging me for it.  You could see where something had been splashed on the wall and run down on the wall behind the sofa and I suspect thats what happened to couch cushion.  We noticed the toilet in our room was leaking slightly as there was water in the grout lines around the toilet.  We called and reported it and they were prompt in coming to fix it.  Only they had to return later because the water was worse and with a simple fix,  the problem was solved.  That night when we went to make up the sofa bed in the A unit, we discovered there was not enough bedding.  2 pillows with no pillow cases and a flat sheet.  no 2nd sheet or blanket so my daughter reported it and bedding was brought to us.The B unit had a garbage disposal that wouldn't drain.  We reported it at the same time as we did the toilet and they attempted to fix it, and while it was better than before, it still was not working as it should.  We also noticed the cold water faucet on the tub was leaking but we did not report that as no one planned on using the tub.Overall, the location is excellent.  I would stay here again but I really feel like the units needed a thorough cleaning.

reviews.title: Hit or miss !!!
reviews.text: I recently stayed at Grandview Las Vegas for work on two separate occasions, and my experiences were drastically different.The first time, I stayed for five days in Building 5, and everything was great. The room was clean, fully stocked with essentials, and overall, it was a comfortable and pleasant stay.The following week, I returned for another five days but was placed in Building 8, and unfortunately, my experience was subpar. Upon checking in, the room was missing basic necessities—no paper towels, no dishwashing liquid, only one roll of toilet paper, and an inadequate amount of towels. There was a broom but no dustpan, and the bathroom didn’t appear to be properly cleaned. Additionally, the pull-out couch had no linen or pillows.I requested these missing items, but it took hours to receive them, and I had to keep calling to follow up because some requests weren’t being fulfilled. As I was unpacking, I kept noticing more things missing, making it an overall frustrating check-in experience. The room itself also felt outdated compared to my previous stay.To make matters worse, the neighbors on my floor were loud, which made it hard to get a good night’s sleep.The stark contrast between my two stays makes me question the consistency in service and maintenance across the property. Based on my second experience, I don’t know if I would return for a third stay.

reviews.title: Dirty Condo
reviews.text: After a long day waiting at the airport for a flight home that was canceled, I called the Grandview {as I am an owner there} to see if I could book 1 night as my flight was rescheduled for the next day. I was told no problem. So I called an uber and we went to the Grandview to book the room.    The Grandview charged me 202.00 including taxes for the night. We then went to the Silverton for a late dinner then back to the room to sleep for early wake up time to head back to the airport. In the morning as I was about to take a shower I notices a lot of hairs on the shower floor. Then I started to look around and the bathroom ceiling was collapsing above the shower. As I walked into the main living area the dresser drawers were open under the tv and one was broken. There was dirt all over the floor in several of the rooms, the fridge was dirty, the remote for the tv was filthy (with what I hope was only chocolate). The kitchen sink was dirty as were all the countertops.    As I left to check out. I asked to speak to a manager. I was introduced to Robbie. I shared all the pictures I took of the rooms condition and asked if the room was ever cleaned. Did I sleep in dirty sheets?  He assured me he was going to take care of this which I took to mean I was not going to be charged for this room. I said thank you. Nothing was done. After three days I called to speak to the general manager and was told he was not in but Robbie was going to refund half of my cost, which has not yet been done.    I am so sorry to say that I am a owner at this property and will be looking to sell as soon as possible. Due to the way I have been treated in this matter. I have stayed at Motel 6 in some of the roughest cities in the US and they were never as bad as THE GRANDVIEW OF LAS VEGAS was on Jan 31st to Feb 1st. 2025

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: On check-in, I questioned why there was a $50 resort fee, instead of the $25. Also we are owners and have not had to pay it in the past. The clerk was very sarcastic, said we booked with points, we should have used the interval. I related we converted to the point system over 10 years ago, and this had never been an issue before. During this exchange, a gentleman in a suit behind the counter(I assumed a manager of some type), listen to the conversation, looked at us, shrugged his shoulders and walked quickly away. Next we had to see another agent to get the parking pass (an excuse for an attempt to get us to sign up of a sales pitch). I told him we are on vacation and not interested in hearing a sales pitch. He related that you get a free buffet during the tour so why not go, I again told him I was not interested, where is quipped “what you are on a diet, yeah”, tossed the parking pass on the counter and walked away. On arrival in our unit, we had to use the toilet plunger to unclog the bathroom sink and the kitchen sink. Had to do this more than once. The Ice Maker in the refrigerator did not work.  The fixture on this same bathroom sink was installed in reverse, to get cold water, you turned on hot, to get hot water you turned on cold. Maintenance never responded. We stayed for a week, and the resort was supposed to replace the towels and take out the trash after 4 days. This NEVER happened. Also there were no washcloths in the bathroom, had to use hand towels.

reviews.title: Staffing shortages are hurting the property
reviews.text: The building we stayed in was one of the buildings that have been redone, and the updates are nice. However, when we checked in, our room had not been cleaned. There was garbage left in the kitchen in shopping bags on the countertops and floor, the bathroom was a complete mess, and the bed was not made at all. I called the front desk, and it took over an hour for someone to come up to our unit to see what we had reported. Once they arrived, they were very apologetic, and quickly made arrangements for us to be moved to a different  unit, and personally escorted us there to make sure that the new room was ready and up to standards. This was the theme for our stay. Things were not quite where they were up to in previous stays, but when attention was brought to the issues, the staff were amazing at addressing it quickly. The impression we were left with was that they just didn't have enough people to keep up with the workload.

reviews.title: Service Above and Beyond
reviews.text: So my key card got deactivated because I held it in my pocket next to my phone and wallet. I didn't discover this until 10 pm.  I got into the lobby, and called the front desk from building 4 (4 buildings away from the office and front desk, a decently lengthy walk).  They sent someone right over, who made sure I was me (made me feel safe), then brought me 4 keys, but they didn't work correctly, so this kind man walked all the way back to the front office, had 4 new keys made, and came back!  They tested perfect, and the rest of the trip was flawless! Despite the heavy use of the resport, the rooms and interior remain clean, in very good and respectable shape (we bought 10 years prior, and they had just completed final construction), and the buildings are situated so that everyone gets a view.  We cannot be happier with our timeshare purchase!  RCI is a great company too, haven't had any complaints!  We've traded into Wisconsin Dells, Dominican Republic, and got a trip to the Bahamas too.  Definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Really Good - and Pretty Bad
reviews.text: This is my second time staying here, and it probably won’t be my last, but I’m in no hurry to return.Honestly, its best attribute is its proximity to my favorite casino (South Point). IF everything is working properly, their rooms are pretty nice, too, with thoughtful layouts, and there isn’t much noise from the hallway or adjacent rooms. The W/D in every room is a wonderful asset that allows for light packing. Room lighting is good. There are plentiful fast elevators, but they could use a couple more luggage carts.But there are significant problems. The key cards are the most temperamental I’ve ever seen. It wasn’t unusual to find two or three people trying to get my building’s outside door open. I had to have my key replaced due to total failure. The clock wasn’t set to the right time, the remote control needed batteries, the toilet ran until the handle was jiggled just right- minor problems like these add up.There is a closet safe, but you must lie on the floor to set the combination.A previous occupant’s shoes were under the bed.There is a lot of emphasis on the five HEATED pools and hot tubs. Temperatures were in the 60’s while I was there, and the pools were NOT heated to any discernible degree. Even the hot tubs weren’t hot enough. There were plenty of clean pool towels, probably because not many guests wanted to swim in ice water.One member of my group fell for the come-on “free” brunch and check for listening to a hard sell for their timeshares. We were late to an appointment because she was basically held hostage for three hours in order to get her $20 earnest money returned to her. There’s no such thing as a free lunch, people!

reviews.title: Great Accomodations
reviews.text: Rooms and contents were all great, staff was extremely courteous and friendly, pools and hot tubs are nicely located and clean. Location is a few miles from the busy strip, but the resort across the street (4-5 minute walk) has a large casino and many restaurants/coffee shops/bars for entertainment. Onsite shuttle to stores (walmart, etc) runs many times in the morning to get food/necessities- very convenient. Best way to the busy "strip" is by ride-share- only a 10 minute ride. Can also take public transport from the casino across the street...public transport is cheap, but takes a bit longer.  Views from 3 sides of the resort is of flat plain to steep mountains that stand tall on the horizon-quite beautiful at sunrise/sunset. Good hub for day trips to Hoover Dam, or a couple of beautiful state or National Parks for sight seeing and hiking. You can get to the Grand Canyon within a couple hours, too...plenty of tours ($)  that will pick you up at the resort or nearby venues.

reviews.text: We will be staying at the Grandview for two weeks.  We have stayed here many times.  This time we are staying in the Primrose building. Our unit was very clean.  New bedding and the matress was very comfy. The unit was perfect size.   The staff is always helpful. Pools are great.  We also love that it is across the stress from the South Point Casino.

reviews.title: Great Family Resort
reviews.text: My son and I love coming to this resort! They have great pools (even a special one for kids), a mini golf course on site, and even a little convenience store and food place. We like to stay in the Rosemary building. We also love the proximity to SouthPoint Hotel and Casino. It is easy to walk over to enjoy a movie, bowling, the arcade, or ice cream parlor. And the restaurants are great too. Not to mention the $1.50 hotdogs around lunch time. Sometimes the western events happening in the arena at SouthPoint are free to the public as well. Like I said, there is so much to do that it is a great spot for taking kids to Vegas.

reviews.title: Family Time

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation at the Grandview
reviews.text: Excellent response to all of our needs. Located in a quiet area of Vegas near freeways and Las Vegas Blvd. Beautiful rooms and plenty of pools and next door to a great casino with a movie theatre, bowling alley and many weekly affordable events.

reviews.title: As a former Vegas resident I approve
reviews.text: very good stay and location. It south strip next to South Point hotel so easy access to a Casino and late night food if need be. The property is large and all rooms were great. We rented a 2br expecting it to be just that BUT it was 2 - FULL 1br condos side by side..so we had to full kitchens and livings rooms. Was perfect for us. Pools were good, and decent size cardio room and enough weight equipment. They even have BBQ grills at certain locations if wanted. Easy access freeway and you can be on strip in 15-20minutes and downtown vegas in 30min. Last but not least a large business center with computer and printers FOR FREE so printing boarding passes or whatever is very convenient. Would stay again.

Belle at the front desk and Deb in Owner Services are always so helpful and welcoming.  We just returned from a week at Grandview in October. reviews.title: Wonder time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I enjoyed the Grandview.  It was my first experience and not my last.  I had a wonderful time.  Several things that I would suggest be done.  To ensure all elevators are in proper working order.  There was only one in building 9 working, and from previous reviews it has not worked in a while.  Any negative comments of a property should be taken care of expeditiously.  Secondly, rooms need to be updated, with carpet remove.  With many having severe allergies such as myself, uncleaned and stained carpet is a trigger for allergies. Finally, the mattress was very uncomfortable.  These need to be changed periodically.  Other than concerns listed above, it is a nice place to stay, and I will stay again.  Thanks!

Plus, South Point Casino is next door where we ate several breakfasts and lunches. The pool area was also nice.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: First of all this vacation started on the wrong path before we even left home. We made reservations in March 2024 at Tahiti Village for our September trip. Two days before we left RCI called us to inform us that Tahiti Village had cancelled our vacation because of a scheduling error.  The only options we had were to either cancel the vacation or to stay at the Grandview. Supposedly it was the only place available.  We were offered nothing else.  The Grandview is further down from the strip and has no shuttle service. We had to rush to rent a car. The check in was quick and uneventful. The customer service person at check in did sort of trick us into a sales breakfast. He presented it as a welcome gift. We are owners at Vacation Village so he told us it would be a quick review. That was inaccurate. The sales manager was rude when we told her we were not interested in buying.  So please do not fall for this trick. The B part of our room did not have hot water. We called maintenance every day and they could never repair. We were not offered any change of rooms. The one maintenance person told us it was good to take a cold shower. I will never stay at this resort again.

reviews.title: Grandview is Falling Short.
reviews.text: We've been owners since 2008, and we come all the time. Recently, it's been grudgingly painful to come. It's sad because I've given my home resort 5+ stars before. So to go from 5+ stars to 1 , that's not a good trend to fall this precipitously fast this soon. The only single reason why we come back is because it's always available,  and the only way we can afford vacations. That's it. As an owner, I feel entitled to call and make requests. Most often, our requests are not fulfilled, which is fine because we are warned that it may not be. This time, when I called, we requested a floor and a certain  building. The receptionist took our request and related the same response. Not only was our request not filled, but the whole building was under renovation. She did not relay us that information. If she had, we would have chosen a different building.  To me, that's a fundamental flaw from management in relaying what I think is important information.  Another inexcusable customer service is there maintance crew. We pay $910 a year in ownership maintenance fees. With that, I expect certain expectations from the resort. I went to the front desk to notify them, that our freezer ice maker wasn't working.  Got our room number, and asking permission to enter our room to fix it. Not only did they not fix the ice maker, they put ice in the catch tray from the communal ice machine that you use at a motel on state street, which I took as an immature lazy passive aggressive way in disrespecting owners at this resort.

Overall cleanliness of the suit was not the greatest. Inside the elevators was not very clean. The grocery shuttle to wallmart was very helpful. reviews.text: We always stay at the Grandview bc we get great deals through the Armed Forces Vacation Club.  Over the years, the Grandview has continued to maintain the property pretty well.  It's pretty kid friendly and they have a large multi-level parking garage if you want to park out of the Vegas sun.  They also also don't pressure you to sign up for a time share presentation when you check in - they try to get you scheduled, but they take no for an answer.

reviews.text: What really go us was housekeeping never Came to clean our room. The staff at the presentation was rude to other customers. We ended up walking out. We have our times share at a different resort. So this was a sad experience for us.

reviews.title: Another wonderful stay!
reviews.text: We stayed in the Iris Building 1201B. It was clean and was fully stocked with everything that we needed for the week. We were given shampoo, dish soap, paper towels, laundry detergent, hand and bath soap. There were no crickets or other bugs in the unit. No one bothered us about listening to a timeshare spill but were offered to do so when we signed in. We kindly declined! The pool was clean and quiet which is why I like this building, because it has a quiet pool that is geared towards adults. I took the shuttle to Walmart, then walked across the street to get breakfast at Jack in the Box and next door to 7/11 to use their cash machine which does not charge me anything, nor my credit union. The only drawback is that you can only take out $200 per day, but in Vegas that could be a good thing!  Then went back to Walmart to get a few snacks. As soon as I walked out the door the shuttle arrived to take me back to the Grandview. They continuously shuttle people back and forth every 20 minutes.  We enjoyed playing slots at South Point and eating at the buffet and other restaurants. Thank you Grandview for another wonderful stay!

reviews.title: The grand view

reviews.title: Too Many Issues

Security stopped responding to our complaints and did nothing.  The "quiet" pool was often filled with a lot of kids jumping, splashing and yelling - again security did nothing.  There are 5 pools at the resort but only 1 of them is "quiet" but some guests don't care and security didn't seem to either.

reviews.title: Location, Location!
reviews.text: The Grandview has been our go to place in Las Vegas when we vacation.  It is close to everything that we like...South Point Casino, the Strip, Planet Fitness, and lots of shopping!  The pools are wonderful and well maintained.  The units are missing a few items that I feel would be appreciated such a large skillet, 2 cup measuring cup....little things.  But overall this place is PERFECT!

reviews.title: WORST Experience at HOME resort!!!
reviews.text: Checked in on Aug 5 at around 2pm. Was given the option to have room in the new building which is the honey suckle building, this building has the power jets in the master bedroom. I had booked for two bedrooms. When I arrived to the rooms, one of the rooms was extremely hot and the other was at a good temperature. But once I checked both rooms, sadly they were not clean, floors had crumbs all around, one of the rooms has smudges of who knows what on the walls, coffee tables also had crumbs and finger prints all over them, and in one of the kitchens there was something spilled on it...again who knows what. Oh, and one of the bedroom sockets had a metal object sticking out of it. Quite bizarre!! I was quite frankly upset. My husband and I drove back to the lobby to speak with someone. I don't remember the gentleman's name but he apologized and offered us to switch rooms. He even offered us a bottle of wine. So we were switched to another room but in the same building. I didn't really care as long as the AC was working.On August 6 we left to venture Nevada and returned to a room with no AC working. The second bedroom was fine no problems. But I was just not happy that the AC was not working again. Like I mentioned before we were given new rooms and even in the new rooms the AC was not working in one of the bedrooms.My husband walked down again to the lobby and spoke with someone. They said they will send someone out so the AC could be looked at and repaired. It took quite a while and it forced us to stay in the resort, just to wait on someone to come over and take care of the AC problem. This caused us to change our schedule, which is not cool at all. Finally, someone came over and the AC unit was fixed.On August 7th, my family and I again ventured off. But now the bedroom where my kids were sleeping the TV in the bedroom was not working. Before we left the resort we drove up to the lobby and did mention it to the front desk people. They said that they will send someone to get that taken care of. Which they did but some how an iPad charger disappeared, not sure how that happened but I really don't like having strangers walk into my rooms with no on there to watch.Later that night, we came back to the resort with the same issue, AC not working!! This was quite frustrating. By the time we got back to our rooms it was really late. It was close to mid night. And once again my husband this time called the front desk. He was told that the building we were in, multiple rooms were having the same issue and that technicians were working on getting the AC to work. My check out date was August 8th...and we were told to hold on and that the AC will be fixed promptly. Not true!! My husband called once again...and this time it was with maintenance he spoke to and they just told him that they were working on it but that soon they will get it fixed. My husband and I waited until around 3am. No one came by and we just gave up. I told him lets just go to bed and just put up with this. We had a long drive back home in a few hours and we did need to get some rest beforehand. I told him to place the DO NOT DISTURB tag on the front door between both bedrooms. I did NOT want to be woken up or get my kids freaked out because some tech decided to go fix the AC unit that late night. Oh but the last call my husband did the female he spoke with said we can move to another room and to leave our belongings in the present rooms we were in. This was around the 3am mark, there was no way I was going to wake up my three children and have them walk to another building to another room. That is just pure ridiculous! She offered that instead of checking out at 10am we can check out later at noon.I'm sorry...I'm an owner here at this resort and I have stayed at the resort at least three times. I have never NEVER had a bad experience here. I just question myself what in the world do they use the annual maintenance fee on? To just replace any broken plates or missing spoons...it should be used to have the AC units up to date and working effectively during the hot summers in Vegas! reviews.title: Not great for young families
reviews.text: These rooms are not the standard 2 bedroom condo. They are one bedroom condos with an A and B side. The kids were on one side and we could not lock the main door that opened up to the inner rooms. If you’re worried about your kids escaping in the middle of the night this place is not for you. Another example of the lack of security is the main doors are accessible to anyone without a key through out the day. Lastly, we had asked for some additional supplies and the maintenance man brought them right in without knocking. It was pretty unsettling that anyone with a master key could enter our room at any time. There was hair left in the shower from the previous guest, the floors were filthy, a cabinet was broken and there were no sheets for the couch beds. We called at 10pm requesting sheets for our toddler. An hour later we tried calling back and could not get an answer from the front desk. Thankfully we had some throw blankets and were able to set up a makeshift bed. We paid a one time “resort fee” and parking was “free.” If you’re checking in on a Friday, keep in mind that everyone else is also checking in at this time and there will be a long line.

reviews.title: Las Vegas apartment
reviews.text: Many good and bad issues.  Any issues we had regarding something not working were fixed ASAP.  Plus there is a free shuttle to Walmart if you want to cook for yourself (salt/pepper, butter, bread, eggs, snacks, etc) or forgot something.  These are one bedroom apartments with FULL kitchen and washer/dryers. They provide dishwashing and dish soap, also coffee. Plenty of towels.    Bathtub was HUGE (and comfy). Several pools to choose from.  I would be surprised if you didn't find one you liked. Super close to South Point Casino which has inexpensive current movies, bowling, and horse shows! Also has a lot of restaurants - some expensive and some not (Coronado's Cafe). South Point has it's own gift shop/store but a bag of chips is about $7.50 so take the free shuttle in the morning to Walmart!
