reviews.text: For starters, we ended up calling maid service to come change the sheets because there were very “questionable stains” all over them when we pulled back the covers the first night. A homeless man was hanging in the lobby of tower 8 one afternoon and when we came home that evening, security was still searching for him since he propped a door open with toilet paper to gain access again. reviews.text: We normally stay at this resort everytime we visit LV. And normally this place is on top of there game. But this time was not so well, upon arrival my wife noticed the floors we not clean. Missing linen for our pullout bed. The housekeeping missed drawers that had junk inside of them. They also missed that the coffee machine was missing, and that there were a lot of missing plates, cups, and utensils. reviews.title: We would definitely book here again - nice clean rooms. Building 5; 12th floor
reviews.text: Our stay was really good. We stayed on the 12th floor of building 5. The rooms were really clean. We stayed 5 FULL Days (Not including arrival and departure - travel days). The staff was nice and we were able to change out towels throughout the week. We stayed in a two bedroom suite - my husband and I and our 21 year old - WHo had a WHOLE suite to herself next door to us - She loved that! The linen was fresh and our view was in the back BUT on the fourth of July we saw EVERY fireworks in the city - I counted at least 20 sets. We didn't get a pushy sales person and enjoyed a nice (mostly) quiet stay - only a couple times did we hear plumbing from next door and people in the hallway, but nothing major...we will definitely book again. ALSO, this is a good location to visit South Point Hotel and Casino - which had an equestrian show! Bowling Alley and nice SPA (and we ate at the Prime Rib place, which was really good). Oh, the only tiny thing is there was NO baking sheet in the rooms (we checked our daughter's room too) I like my  toast from the oven and had nothing to place it on....but that was minor compared to rest of the stay. Also, we were in and out so much that we can't talk much about other amenities. My husband went to the gym one time - and it was 115-120 degrees so not much pool time during the day. The parking fills up quickly, but nothing major, just a few steps.

reviews.title: Not Extremely Grand but A Little Grand
reviews.text: The Grandview is a good place if you want to stay somewhere off the strip or at least off of all the traffic and Bajillion people. The Grandview has several buildings which are nice. We stayed in the Iris building, which is technically the oldest building and it showed. The Iris building didn’t necessarily have good airflow or air conditioning in all the hallways that we walked through. But overall, it was semi-clean. The room that we stayed in was quiet and pretty clean although there were a couple of spots that could’ve used extra cleaning such as the couch and parts of the bathroom. But it was a decent room nonetheless; as for sleeping, the room sleeps 4 and the pullout couch is not comfortable unless it’s still a couch and if it is still a couch, it makes your back stiff unless maybe if you were a child. We were near the quiet pool which wasn’t always quiet because sometimes children were in there playing loud games, but the majority of the time people respected the rule. Staff was courteous every time we interacted with them. And check in and check out process was very easy.

While has been our favorite resort to visit when in Vegas, there are improvements that need to be made for future visits.

The front desk folks will talk down to you and try and intimidate you so you just accept the substandard conditions. The room safe never worked, The rooms were somewhat filthy, the card readers throughout the property worked sometimes and most times did not. By the pool ares several chairs were very unsafe to sit in and need to be repaired or just thrown away. Most of the hot tubs were turned off because they just did not work. We called in multiple items of concerns and they closed the tickets without completing the request. It appears ignoring the guest when a request comes in and talking down to a guest comes from the top down! I not understanding why RCI has an office there and we were prohibited to raise our concerns with them. Everyone only wants to hear the good news and you plug your ears on the bad stuff. What angers me the most is that I asked to talk with a manager several times and not once did anyone respond. Disappointed with the management and RCI at this Resort!

reviews.title: Great Location and Our Best Stay In Vegas
reviews.text: I have stayed at other Vegas locations but Grandview was the best so far especially with South Point Casino being right next door. The first surprise was the double units when you open the door from the hallway. You are greeted with a foyer with 2 doors, A on the right and B on the left. I had requested a 2 bedroom unit. What we got was 2  identical one bedroom fully equipped apartments with full kitchens, large bathrooms., a king sized bed, living room, dining room, a soaking tub and washer and dryer. We could go back and forth between units through the foyer without going into the hallway.  Southpoint Casino next door has several  restaurants, fast food, ice cream, a buffet , bowling alley and loose slots. The Grandview has a free shuttle everyday to take you to the nearby Walmart shopping center. There’s also a city bus that goes up and down Las Vegas Blvd from Southpoint that’s $2.50 and $1.50 for seniors.  My BFF and I can’t wait to go back to Vegas and stay at the Grandview.

reviews.title: Huge Resort Suitable as Base for Grand Circle Trip
reviews.text: We used The Grandview at Las Vegas as a place to stay for a few days before we left to tour Valley of Fire State Park and Zion, Bryce Canyon, and Grand Canyon (North Rim) National Parks for several days. Our unit was very nice but it was in the building at the back of the resort on I-15, which was a long walk to any of the resort pools, including the main pool. Check-in was a zoo and took too long. The resort is much larger than when we stayed there several years ago. It's still well-maintained and the units are quite nice but it's a LONG way from most of what Las Vegas has to offer, especially considering most Strip and Downtown resorts now charge for parking. You absolutely need a vehicle unless you really just plan to stay at the resort and use its facilities (which are extensive, admittedly.) We returned to LV after our tour of the parks and stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise resort which is very nice and much better located to enjoy local attractions.

reviews.text: Belle provides the best customer service. Very knowledgeable  and friendly. I would never stay at the Grendview if it wasn't for Belle's superior services.The rooms need some refreshing.  Antiquated furniture and appliances

reviews.title: Inadequacy
reviews.text: This resort was unable to house myself and 5 guests as we had planned due to the poorly maintained rooms. We lost 1.5  hours of our vacation dealing with this issue even after calling the day before arrival to make certain the rooms would be in good order.The management initially tried to correct the issue. Another manager completely failed to understand the real issue at hand which was making sure rooms were appropriately maintained, clean and in good working order BEFORE being assigned to owners and guests. This same manager had an argumentative demeanor and told me he would do this, this and this for me....all of which didn't address the problem at hand. I asked for my points to be refunded and he refused that repeatedly.  I am very disappointed in what the Grandview has become. I hope they raise the bar.

reviews.title: Another enjoyable stay!
reviews.text: We have stayed at Grandview Las Vegas several times and have never been disappointed. The location is convenient and within walking distance to South Point Hotel & Casino. A rental car is recommended as it is South of the airport and not really close to any other walking locations, however there are many pools and other activities on site.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We come back to the Grandview every year. The rooms are clean and spacious, and the check in/check out process has always been fast and easy. The Grandview is right next to South Point Casino. It's an easy walk over to Southpoint for gaming, restaurants, movies, bowling etc. You will be asked to go on a timeshare presentation at Grandview, but they will take NO for an answer if that's not something you are interested in.

reviews.title: Nice place. Can be loud next to SouthPoint and the freeway. Very easy to get in and out of compared to others.
reviews.text: Nice place. Can be loud next to SouthPoint and the freeway. Very easy to get in and out of compared to others.

reviews.title: Grandview Resort, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Our one bedroom unit was spacious and clean. We overlooked a pool area from the 5th floor. The hall ways were quiet as was our overnight hours. Multiple pool and hottub areas. Also a "kiddy" pool and splash pad. A nice onsight mini put, though we did not play. There is a buisness area with PC's and printer for guests. Southgate Casino with all it has to offer is right next door. A great stay.

reviews.title: Not like it used to be
reviews.text: Rooms were dirty, dusty, appliances were either not working or damaged. THe hallways in building were filthy, was there an entire week and they never once vacuumed.  The elevators would take forever, then when they did open the staff with towels or other boxes would be taken up entire elevator.  The rooms are never cleaned even just once during our stay to refresh towels etc. we had asked for two lock offs close to each other because of small kids etc.  I had called twice over a two month period before arriving to make this request. Both times they told me no problem.  Upon check in they had us in opposite hallways no where near each other.  Front desk told me, they had no obligation nor guarantee that requests would be satisfied.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: The resort is somehat dated but very well kept. Everything is clean and works, the unit kitchen items are minimal, but they bring you what you need if you ask. Staff is friendly. They really want their guests to have a pleasant stay. The RCI timeshare sales tactics are awful, but Grandview Resort is a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Another great stay at the grandview. Friendly staff, great amenities (multiple pools/hot tubs , work out room, convenience store(with short order kitchen ) , outdoor bbq’s, very clean resort, south point hotel/casino right across a very quiet street (numerous restaurants , theatres, bowling…..  great location for families, couples or you’re buddies on a golf trip

reviews.title: Always a good place to stay
reviews.text: This is my home resort & it is always provides the best of the best. I would recommend staying any time of year. It is about 5 miles from the middle of the strip, so a car is preferable. South Point Casino is across the avenue from Grandview & has lots of non casino activities..

reviews.title: It was okay
reviews.text: Not handicapped accessible no wheelchairs, no pots and pans in the kitchen, no sheets and pillows for the sofa bed.  Keys malfunctioned. Opened down stairs but not upstairs and Vice versa.  It was clean

reviews.title: Clean and cozy
reviews.text: Our stay was amazing staff was awesome and we loved jacuzzi bathtub.our one room was spacious and very clean. We were able to check in and check out very easily. The bed was super comfortable we traveled for family and our daughters were very comfortable and had a great time! Rooms were all smoke free which was very nice. We enjoyed the kids pool in our building as well

reviews.title: Grandview Resort at Las Vegas
reviews.text: The rooms were clean and comfortable. The fitness facility was fantastic it covered all my needs.The pool and hottub were a nice place to relax after spending time on the strip. The beds and pillows were very comfortable. The kitchen supplied all of our needs and the service from staff was great.

reviews.title: Worst Stay Ever
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Las Vegas Grandview Resort over 30 times in the past few years asa owner at Vacation Village  at Parkway. Last week I was  leaving that Wyndham in Austin, TX for the Grandview. I pre-coordinated my arrival for the building and room I wanted to stay in. I called ahead 3 hours prior to arrival. Upon arrival, the room was not ready and a different room was assigned. The room was missing several items  and took several hours to prepare for my move in. I contacted Ass. Manager Robby on several issues during stay: Missing items, uncleanliness, keys not working, rude staff, ect. I left messages, over several days but he never returned my messages. I had to personally walk to offices to get results. I later contacted Manager Joe Gonzales and was he  also failed to respond, and return calls or address issues in a timely manner. The place has gone to the dogs! The pools and hot tub almost never cleaned or had excessive chlorine  which burned eyes. Carts constantly left in hallways  and when reported, remained for days sometimes.I consistently complained about the rooms "foul smell and dirty linen before sleeping on sheets and pillow cases but never got feedback!I have been coming here for years. Since C-19 the staff is rude and unprofessional, managers unresponsive to complaints and fail to return calls or follow up on complaints, issues or concerns. I have written  several complaints on bookings, lack of service and unprofessionalism from resorts and RCI issues and always request following up and replays/feedback and have yet to get any!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Again, I want management to contact me : majorgstamps@gmail.com 210-992-8533 ASAP!!!!I have written  several complaints on bookings, lack of service  and unprofessionalism from resorts and RCI issues and always request following up and replays/feedback and have yet to get any!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Again, I want management to contact me : majorgstamps@gmail.com 210-992-8533 ASAP!!!!

reviews.title: Again Very Dirty Unit
reviews.text: Unit very dirty!! Unit maintenance is nonexistent.  Shower leaked all over the floor due to drip tray gone and is starting to rot the cabinet kick area.  Freezer leaks into freezer and refrigerator. This unit has had this problem for a long time. Not all burners worked.The positive they have nice check in personal and at least one very helpful security man.

reviews.title: Nice lil getaway
reviews.text: Super fast check in, rooms were nice kids really enjoyed the rooms. The kids really didn’t want to leave the room they were enjoying their time. We were not able to check out the pool due to a strong windstorm but the pool looked nice.

reviews.title: Nice resort, but.....
reviews.text: Resort staff very friendly, cleanliness of rooms not to be desired; toilet and tub filthy, walls need cleaned, vents need cleaned, air filters changed, windows cleaned.  Grounds were properly maintained.

reviews.title: Great resort but not very close to the strip
reviews.text: The resort was very nice and easy to arrive to. The only thing I would have liked to have was some sort of shuttle service to the strip. The resort is well-maintained and the staff was very courteous and helpful.

reviews.title: Vacation for family
reviews.text: It was nice just didn’t understand why we put at the back building I like being in the front buildings closer to the silverton but it’s always nice to get away with family the spaces was perfect for everyone to enjoy themselves the front desk check people were very nice

reviews.title: Always as Expected
reviews.text: It's always nice when you go to a place year after year that it's consistent.  The staff is always amazing,  They've kept the rooms upgraded and looking nice.  With the issues these days with staffing there has been some cleaning issues  but they always make it right.

reviews.title: great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Lots of parking and close to the South Point Hotel & casino yet away from the traffic on the strip. Convenient on and off ramp to the freeway makes for easy travel times. Staff is really friendly. Great resort choice for family vacation in LasVegas.

reviews.title: DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text: A little disappointed with the hotel, I have stayed many times and it is the first time that I have seen so many defects at the same time, from the drainage of the bathrooms in general, shower and sink, to the kitchen doors in poor condition and The lamps in the room were not working properly. I think they can improve since they are a very good option, but they have not received adequate maintenance.

reviews.title: Their age is showing and nobody cares
reviews.text: The size of the units were great but do not go here with kids, do not expect anything to work, and the staff just doesn't care. A 2 bedroom is 2 single units with no security or no access to both rooms. You would have to ask your young children to deadbolt themselves in and have no way to get to them. The washer was broken, the stove was broken, the dishwasher was full of water. We asked for a baking sheet and had 3 people walk into our room unannounced in 30 minutes and none brought the baking sheet. When they called later to confirm we got it, which we never did, they just laughed it off. We had 2 other occasions of staff just walking in our room when we were there so I can only imagine what happened when we were not there. We were asked daily to come and get our welcome gift, which was a presentation to buy there, typical time shares, but the rooms we were given would never entice us to buy. They were very rundown and dirty.We were very disappointed, definitely not what we expected for an RCI Gold crown resort.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay. Okay amenities
reviews.text: Decent size unit for two people. Kind of weird having a tub in the bedroom that isn’t a jetted tub. Pools are shallow but nice. Don’t take them up on the “free buffet and gift card offer” unless you want to sit and eat the buffet with a timeshare representative. Buffet meal is okay but nothing to write home about. Overall nice stay.

reviews.title: Las Vegas at it's best
reviews.text: Have a great time with everything only a short walk from your room. The room itself is Exira large and up to date, the pool area is beautiful, and The South Point Casino Resort is steps away. .I highly recommend you check it out..

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: It's really nice to be able to check in 24/7. Our plane landed just after midnight and check in was quick and easy. The room had a view of the pool. The room was nice, spacious, and had a full kitchen

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: The Grandview at Las Vegas was a very nice resort, conveniently located next to where we were bowling. The check-in process was absolutely amazing and friendly. Every single time we called down for anything we had it within 20 minutes. Great service definitely would recommend

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: I love how you don't feel trap with limited space as you do in other hotels. This is basically an apartment. It's so quiet and spacious Would recommend especially with kidsAnd south point is cross the street with activities for the family like bowling and movie theater

reviews.title: Comfy Stay
reviews.text: Our favorite place to stay when coming to Vegas for our equine events. Located right next to South Point, we are within walking distance to the barn. We like having a “homey” place to say when staying in town for a week where we can prep meals if we want. Quieter for sleeping. And enjoy the large tub for salt baths after a long day of work and showing our horses!

reviews.title: Fair
reviews.text: Need more caring for the place and from the service. It used to be better than that. I had trouble with the key 3 times on the same day. Had to do 3 go and back to the front desk which is very far. At the 3rd time they sent me the security to make sure I was able to get in. I asked for compensation for all the trouble and get none.

reviews.title: Resort is great but no shuttle to the Strip anymore
reviews.text: One of the best resorts in Las Vegas. However, without a shuttle to the Strip, a rental car is now a must or be prepared to pay $ for taxi or ride share. The cost really adds up quickly. Staff is friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Kid Friendly for Las Vegas
reviews.text: Grandview is a bit out of town but is a wonderful location to just have some family downtime. We would just travel to town and do our activities/shows for the day then retreat to our space here at the Grandview which was nice. Pools and hot tubs are great. There is one pool area just geared for smaller children which is a bonus. They also have on-site put putt golf. The "games" upstairs you had to pay for which was very disappointing since we were REQUIRED to pay a $50 resort activity fee. They need to do a better job at disclosing this. The service was slow. It seemed like there were always folks around but only specific people could help you. Always took a long time when going to the front desk.

reviews.title: Close to the strip, but away from the hustle
reviews.text: The Grandview is located south of the strip, within distance of a $15 Lyft ride. My husband and I used Lyft for 6 different trips downtown and feel we still saved $200 over a rental car. South Point is right across the street and provides 9 great restaurants, a movie theatre and a bowling alley. Plenty to do at this resort, even in the winter weather.

reviews.title: Amazing Grandview at Las Vegas
reviews.text: I have been here numerous times and never been disappointed. Rooms are spacious and very clean. The staff and Manager go out of their way to assure your comfort. I love being away from the hustle of the strip but yet only a 10-minute drive to get there. I Will be staying here again and again.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Not enough amenities room was cold and did not have bed sheets was looking forward for hot tub jacuzzi but it has no indoor pool. Transportation was not available and not close to main attraction but overall good

reviews.title: Average Stay
reviews.text: Maintenance has certainly declined over the years and the rooms were missing lots of supplies and utensils. Drain issues all 8 days, sinks, washers, etc...  Sink disposal not working and suds galore when someone else did their laundry and the foam of suds blanketed our laundry area into the kitchen.  Unmade bed upon our arrival with linens stacked everywhere, weren't sure if it was clean or not...???  Always loved this resort in the past, unit sizes, convenience of the casino, etc...  Not overly impressed this time and would definitely consider other resorts next time.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Great place people where friendly, service was easy if you needed something they brough it up on a timely manner. Would stay here again without a doubt. Smoke free great for families. Pools were clean

reviews.title: Outstanding!!
reviews.text: This is a very nice resort, with many amenities.  We booked through RCI because we had a few remaining points.  We were a single bedroom unit, and very pleased with the unit.  It had everything we needed (could use a pizza pan).  We loved that it is off the strip, as were here to do outdoor activities in the surrounding areas (Zion, Valley of Fire, Red Rock Canyon, etc.). The Southpoint Casino is amazing and has many activities as well.  We would definitely come again and highly recommended to couples and families.

reviews.title: Convenient Vegas timeshare
reviews.text: Resort is 5 miles South of the main Strip area so it is easy to get around without the congestion of the Strip but close enough if you want to go there. Right next door to South Pointe casino with several dining options, movies and bowling.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: I was very happy with the resort, check in and check out was very fast. The resort was clean and very quiet for the size of the resort. Close to restaurants, casinos. I would definitely go back the next time I am in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Enjoyable and comfortable
reviews.text: I travel with my son and our expectations were exceed. The only small inconvenience is the location relative to the Las Vegas strip. However the value of the property offsets this. I would recommend this property to friends and family.

reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: This is our repeat stay at Grandview Las Vegas. Like the location. Staff polite and helpful. Apartment large and well equipped (albeit this time a few equipment and utensils not working properly but quickly replaced) Would have preferred TV offers more programs

reviews.title: Good property but staff issues
reviews.text: Good property. Needs some updating. Staff unconcerned if you get hurt. They are only worried about covering themselves and not about the customer. I fell due to a sidewalk that was uneven due to tree roots. It was a bad fall and I was bleeding. They were more worried about taking a report than helping with the injuries. I have owned here for several years and am very disappointed.

reviews.title: Great family location
reviews.text: Great place to stay, very safe and offers many amenities and services. Southpoint Casino next door with huge casino, kid friendly, great entertainment and events thru out the year as well good variety of restaurants.

reviews.title: poor upkeep for those high maintenance fees.   every room i had, had something wrong
reviews.text: dirty rooms sheets on my bed had been slept on and had sec stains. then they changed it with sheets filled with lint balls.  One room had bowl in the toliet, one room stove was cracked.  another room wash machine was broke missing pans(they did bring new ones) our complaints were answered but it should never be that many.  Why pay high maintenance fees if the property is not kept up

reviews.title: Relaxing getaway during Super Bowl Week
reviews.text: We love staying at the Grandview! Close enough to the action, while being far enough away to partake in some tranquility. South Point right across the street with any amenity you could need! Can't wait for our next trip!

reviews.title: Mixed Review
reviews.text: I've visited this resort over the last decade several times and have been extremely satisfied. I question the advantage of being a Platinum member.  I reserved a 2 unit early 2023 for Super Bowl weekend. For the first time, I was not happy with my unit in Bldg. 6, unit 1208-B. The A unit was fine.  My B unit had a horrible smell and every drawer and cabinet was open.  The sofa bed was partially pulled and the pillows were on the chair.  The silverware was spread out on the counter in the kitchen area.  I called the front desk and was moved to the 21st floor. Upon checking in I was told my unit had already been picked for me.  A staff member told me that as a Platinum member, I should have been in Bldg. 5. As a Platinum I hope to get privileges since I pay for this status. I think it's time the units get a facelift. My 1 star cleanliness review below is based on the first unit with the odor... The room I was moved to on the 21st floor was clean and did not have an odor.

reviews.title: resort vacation at the Grandview at Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Resort rooms and facilities staff were wonderful The resort representatives were very helpful, courterous, and welcoming as well as efficiently dealing with any requests of them. wonderful time at the Grand View.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great service and amazing front desk. Really helpful and quick response. I love their fast service and they were very attentive to any issue that came along during my vacation time with them. Truly recommend

reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.text: We have stayed at The Grandview many times. It is conveniently located off of the Strip. The resort is beautiful, the rooms are comfortable and the staff are friendly. Definitely one of our favorite stays when we visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: We have been to the Grandview many times.  It is our favorite in Vegas.   It is very easy to find the dates and units we want.  Very nice accommodations and very convenient location.   Washer and dryer in the room and the full kitchen are nice.

reviews.title: Perfect Stay
reviews.text: Frequent Visitor.  Love the location near the airport m, casino in walking distance. Great for a group of 8 comfortably. Love the adjoining rooms. Set up for the Perfect fo Privacy. Looking forward to next time.

reviews.title: Better Upkeep and Cleaning Needed
reviews.text: Could be a beautiful resort except for roaches, below average cleaning, slow bathroom sink drains, However, the desk/management are very responsive to the myriad of problems.  We were move to a suite that was roach-free although cleanliness issues persisted (dirty bed linen, spare linen had not been exchanged after last guests, floor not cleaned until requested, slow drains that had to be plunged)

reviews.title: Dirty, dusty, noisy…
reviews.text: I am writing this review to express my disappointment with the recent experience I had during my stay at this hotel. As a seasoned traveler who spends approximately 20 weeks per year on the road, cleanliness and tranquility are essential aspects of accommodation for me.Upon arrival, I was dismayed to find that the room assigned to me was completely dirty and dusty. Furthermore, both the garbage disposal and the dishwasher were inoperable, necessitating a room change which did not happened. While I appreciate the swift resolution to this issue the initial state of the room was unacceptable and not reflective of the standards I expect from this establishment.In addition to the cleanliness concerns, I also experienced a significant disturbance during my stay due to loud machinery noises emanating from the floor above. When I brought this to the attention of the staff, I was informed that there was nothing that could be done, and I would have to endure the disturbance.As a loyal customer, I must emphasize that cleanliness and a peaceful environment are non-negotiable aspects of my stay. While I understand that maintenance issues may arise, it is crucial that steps are taken to mitigate disturbances and ensure a comfortable experience for guests.

reviews.title: I would not go back…
reviews.text: I used to come to this place a lot, it was a great economical option in Las Vegas, unfortunately on this occasion they gave us a very old and very dirty room. The staff was friendly and tried to help, however, the cleanliness of the place was definitely unacceptable and they couldn't be bothered to want to do it again.The dishwasher was not working and had to be completely replaced, the food grinder was not working either, in addition, all the time we could hear a noise coming from above and they told us that they could not do anything about this because they were machines that were on the floor highest of the building. Frankly I wouldn't return to this place. I know it is not a luxury place but cleanliness is non-negotiable.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel for a great price
reviews.text: This hotel was my selection for my son's college graduation present. He wanted to visit Los Vegas and the Grandview didn't disappoint, the trip was great because of the care and attention of the staff and management. The room was very pleasant and comfortable. We had a 2 bedroom room and it was very nice and clean. This hotel is on the South end of the strip but worth the stay. Would highly recommend for families and couples. And last but not least, this hotel is next to the South Point Hotel and Casino. This casino is by far a hidden gem in Los Vegas it's clean, nice, and the staff was pleasant and professional.

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable, relaxing
reviews.text: We are repeat vacationers at Grandview. The units are spacious, we like the shuttle to Walmart, numerous pools with an amazing casino across the street (Southpoint) with several awesome restaurants, buffet, bowling alley, movie theatre, equestrian arena.  Other eateries within easy walking distance, buses to strip, outlet mall.

reviews.title: A bit disappointed
reviews.text: As owners at The Grandview we were very much looking forward to this stay. We were delayed due to a change in flight times and I have to firstly say that when I called to let them know the lady I spoke with was really helpful and lovely. Checkin was good, however when we got to our unit ( in building 5) when we opened the door we found an employee sitting on the couch watching TV. He quickly removed food from out of the fridge and exited. We have not visited for quite a few years now but noticed quite a decline in amenities. No paper towel, only one roll of toilet paper etc. it was also very obvious that the floor needed vacuuming, desperately. We found used soap in the shower stall, as well as a dried kitchen towel. We were in unit A, my sister and her hubby were in unit B. They found that the garbage bin in the kitchen had not been emptied and was stinking up the area, they took this to the garbage chute immediately. When they went to bed they found an empty carton of coconut water plus numerous empty candy packets under the bed. Quite disappointing to see the decline in standards and services when owner fees keep rising.

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: The Grandview in Las Vegas had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay.  The fully equipped kitchen allowed us to save money eating in.  We felt safer away from the strip a little ways, but were still able to travel there easily.

reviews.title: excellent!
reviews.text: Everything was very good, at a good price!!!, the hotel is well equipped, its areas clean, the room complete, the reception was fast, in general everything was very good and its prices are also very good.

reviews.title: Relaxing Stay
reviews.text: It was a very nice relaxing stay. It was clean everyone was very professional friendly and accommodating. Great staff shuttle driver Jerome was very informative and such an amazing personality. I enjoyed the crab & shrimp salad from the Oyster Bar Restaurant

reviews.title: Cleanliness
reviews.text: Yards/grounds cleanliness are well maintained and lighted. It is the inside that we noticed a problem. A small dog peed on the carpet. Owner did not even bother to clean and just looked around then left.

reviews.title: Mecum motorcycle auction.
reviews.text: Myself and friends were attending the Mecum motorcycle auction at Southpoint Resort and Casino across the street.  Perfect location.  We have done this three times and have had very trouble free stays.  We will be back.

reviews.title: Pleasure
reviews.text: The unit we rented was appointed well but needed attention to detail.  We had an issue with water pressure and water temperature in the shower, issue was taken care of but not until  management was involved.

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: excellent location and service.  we didn't stay the full 7 days because other scheduled events but the time we were there was fabulous. We also got a chance to see the new improvement to the units and the customer service was top shelf.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great place to stay, close to South Point with plenty to do even with children and great places to eat nearby. Walking distance to many places plus pools, gym, bbq grills and mini golf course. This was my first to this resort.

reviews.title: grandview
reviews.text: We stay at Grandview several times a year! Always enjoy it! Quick check in, nice rooms with washer and dryer, good parking. Next door to South Point casino which has lots of fun slots and keno and video poker.

reviews.title: Home Office
reviews.text: perfect trip - used the resort as home office - worked during the day, played at nightroom was clean.   it was close to the strip and Red Rock Canyon   Staff were very friendly and professional   I will return

reviews.title: Stay at the Grandview
reviews.text: The Grandview is very convinient property to stay at if you like to gamble.  Unlike other timeshares in Vegas, you have to get in your car and/or walk a distance to get to a casino.  The Grandview is also located close to family so this is our timeshare of choice when traveling to Vegas.

reviews.title: Good stay but intrusive housekeeping
reviews.text: Had a good stay but be sure to keep the latch on your door on checkout day. Housekeeping will try to get into your room before checkout time and you may be surprised. They knocked, waited 3 seconds, then tried to barge in to clean the room.

reviews.title: Stay at the Grandview Las Vegas
reviews.text: Overall very nice accommodations. The mattress needs to be replaced, isn’t comfortable at all. Even though there is a sign asking not to use the jacuzzi tub after 8:00 pm, some occupants decide to use it at midnight; it is extremely loud!

reviews.title: Grandview Las Vegas Getaway
reviews.text: Needed a room close to South Point Plaza, this was right next door.  Room was great, price was awesome. Loved having two separate suites. Would recommend bringing your own pillow, theirs were not comfortable!

reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay away.
reviews.text: They have Spacious rooms with a great view of the surrounding areas. Convenient as amenities are just a walk away. Clean facilities and courteous staff. Reasonable cost for the quality of facilities. We will choose to stay here again.

reviews.title: Home away from home.
reviews.text: I've stayed here many times with my family. I love the size of the unit! My boys are young men now so we booked a second unit. It was so nice to have separate spaces for music and watching shows. We love all the amenities. My personal favorite is the large tub to soak in everyday! Being next to Southpoint is great too! We will be back soon!

reviews.title: Timeshare at Grandview
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom adjoining unit as part of our timeshare exchange. Amenities were basic in line with a 3 star property. We had a few problems like non- working safe, torn curtain, and missing kitchen items but nothing too big. Overall a fine family vacation location, best when you can use the outdoor pools.

reviews.title: Always our go to resort
reviews.text: I have been using this resort yearly for the last 8 years.  I love that it's off strip but right next to South Pointe where you have access to casino, restaurants, movie theater, bowling, bingo......We literally never go to the strip.  We always get a 2 bedroom and it works for us but it is two 1 bedroom units connected with a small foyer so it's very private and you get two living spaces.  If you have young children however, it may not work for you. The units are always clean and stocked, however this is the first year we had no towels in one bathroom and no bedding for the sofa couch in either unit.  We called housekeeping and it was taken care of in a reasonable amount of time.

reviews.title: GREAT PLACE
reviews.text: UPON ENTERING THE ROOM I NOTICED THE APPLIANCES, AND FURNITURE, TV'S, ETC ETC. WERE ALL OLDER. i MUST GIVE CREDIT TO THE RESORT, AND THEIR CLEANING STAFF! The room was immaculate, The appliances were immaculate. Only place I could find any dust was on the blinds.We did not realize a two bedromm unit is actually two separate fully equipped apartments. When you enter, there is a small hallway which acesses A an B units. Both units have a bedroom, and sofa beds in the living room.We will definatly be back next time in Vegas. THANKS GRANDVIEW

reviews.title: Fallen in cleanliness and maintenance
reviews.text: Stains on the couch, orange peels under the front of the couch, dishwasher installed not level and leaking. Maintenance and house keeping needs a complete overhaul. This is our 3rd stay over the years and very disappointed the units are not being kept up.

reviews.title: Dirty Room
reviews.text: After traveling 12 hours, we checked into the Grandview at 2:00 am, and went to bed immediately. When we woke we found that we had slept in DIRTY bedding (Long hair on the sheets; Dried Body Fluids on the sheets and night stand next to the bed). There was also no Iron in the room, the coffee pot was dirty, the stove was missing one of the burner dials.  When we told the Manager On Duty they did send someone to clean the room. Bedding was changed, two (2) new irons were delivered, dial was replaced on the stove, and a new coffee pot was delivered. The "Body Fluids" on the nightstand were not cleaned. A second complaint was filed with the Manager On Duty. Again the nightstand was not cleaned.

reviews.title: Vacation Stay At The Grandview at Las Vegas
reviews.text: I highly recommend this resort for a number of reasons:  it is right on Las Vegas Blvd;  close to the strip casinos; their is a casino within walking distance of the resort; and all services and service staff at the resort are excellent.

reviews.title: Before new year trip
reviews.text: we stayed here in End of December.   Grounds and pool were nice.  heated pools were nice in December.    Condo do show the age but were clean and well maintained.   would stay here again.   has a large tub in master bedroom.  Bath room has shower that is sep.    carpet older but clean    Southpoint is just accross the street short walk.

reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: Came in early for a work trip with two co-worker friends and we used my timeshare. This property was a very convenient location and great property. Staff very friendly and glad we chose this property.

reviews.title: Building outdated
reviews.text: Staff were very friendly and quick to resolve any issue. Disappointed with having to call for support to use the dishwasher. Our kids joined us on second day and there was no bedding for pull out couch.

reviews.title: RECOMMENDABLE
reviews.text: Very friendly staff when checking in, they looked for someone to assist us in Spanish. Very clear instructions and regulations. comfortable, clean rooms. well equipped kitchen. We had other very pleasant guests. We will stay at this development again. thank you.

reviews.title: Worst Vacation Stay Ever! Never again will me, my family or friends will consider staying at the Grandview resort.
reviews.text: Worst Vacation Stay Ever! Never again will me, my family or friends will consider staying at the Grandview resort.

reviews.title: We love Grandview
reviews.text: We had a great stay wouldn’t having any other way. Grandview has become our second home when we visit Vegas. Looking forward to many more trips with the family on future vacations. Very peaceful and relaxing

reviews.title: Best time ever
reviews.text: The overall condition of the property was nice, the close proximity of other entertainment. I will more than happy to encourage family and friends to join RCI. I've been a member for over four years now and I think it was well worth investing in the program.

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: The Grandview has been a wonderful place for us while in Las Vegas.  We have served 4-5 rooms at one time, several times this year, for family gatherings.  The children love the “Kiddy Pool”, and my adult children love the quietness of the environment.  We stay at The Grandview at least 4 times a year.  It is clean, the personnel are kind, and we always look forward to coming back.

reviews.title: The Grandview Resort
reviews.text: Always like staying with the Grandview.  The apartment units are great at the Grandview Resort.  Their daily shuttle to the grocery store is wonderful and the customer service is always courteous and welcoming.  Definitely recommended stay

reviews.title: Not the resort I remember
reviews.text: The resort used to smell clean. Cleanliness is lacking. Dishes were dirty & pots were greasy. Stains on the woodwork and walls. Pot smoking was prevalent everywhere outside. Not enough handicapped sp.

reviews.title: We're coming back!
reviews.text: They accommodated us with our four rooms and whatever we needed they brought to us in a timely manner. Loved the rooms and accessibility. My mother in law needed her service dog which was not a problem for this hotel and it had disability access!

reviews.title: Great New Year's Eve trip to Vegas
reviews.text: We had a great time at the GV LV.  Stayed for 5 days over NYE.  Had 2 units connected by a small entryway.  The staff was great and the units are very clean and well stocked.  Having Southpoint next door was a huge bonus!  You can walk over for a very reasonably priced meal and gift shop that sold inexpensive alcohol.  Be sure to buy there and not at a liquor store on the way from the airport like we did.  The only drawback was the Ubers back and forth from the strip - very pricey during the holiday but not a reason not to stay again.  Highly recommend the Grandview.

reviews.title: Home away from home.
reviews.text: Took a short vacation and the staff here did a great job at making me and my family like we are at home. If we had any issues which we did, the staff quickly addressed it. Love this resort and it's location next to South Point.

reviews.title: I really recommend it!
reviews.text: I really like everything, I have no complaints, you have everything to cook, they give you ride to Walmart, the soutpoint casino it’s next door, is 10 min drive to the strip, checkout and checkin was super fast!

reviews.title: great place
reviews.text: Grandview is the best place to stay, overall clean! Had great time with friends.  everything is close to the property. you can just walk to Southpoint to have fun! a lot of parking space and free parking!!!

reviews.title: fun New Year’s stay
reviews.text: We  always love the Grandview- the rooms are beautiful and spacious with just about everything that we could need in the room.  anything extra we did need or any maintenance issues were handled very promptly with just a call to the desk. My sons room needed a new fridge as it was not getting very cold and they immediately brought him a new one up. we also asked for cookie sheets, and they were brought up immediately. We own a week at a sister resort in Florida  and never get the service or accommodations that we get here at the Grandview

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This was a Christmas family trip. I made an error and had my days mixed up. I was a day early, but the staff was very accommodating. I was able to have my rooms (A and B) a day early and not have to move from my units. The office staff is very friendly and helpful. Finding the unit was easy, parking was plentiful, and it was very clean. The unit itself was very clean, and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.  We were out and about most of the time, so we did not use any of the amenities they offered. But we did see people enjoying themselves at the pool, jacuzzi, and playing mini golf. This property is about 25 mins from the strip and the outlet mall is on the main same street. There are plenty of restaurants in the area as wellMy only complaint is that, for the most part, the unit is soundproof, but if someone turned on their tub faucet from an adjacent unit, it was very loud! I was awakened around 12 am by the gushing sound of water in the pipes. It was so loud it startled me! Half of my family stayed in the other unit and complained of the same noise. Overall, our stay was great. I do recommend this property to others.

reviews.title: ok
reviews.text: Other than both bathroom sinks being clogged up plus very few cooking utensils we enjoyed the stay and will return here again.  Easy to get around or just relax. we found this location & the amenities to fit all our needs.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Accessible and very good accommodations for our family get-together. Excellent place to stay, close to shops, and dining facilities. Rooms are nice and clean. We will continue to stay at Grandview for our vacation trips to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Happy with The Grandview at Las Vegas resort
reviews.text: We loved the double rooms for our family holiday gathering.  Plenty of space and freedom in the rooms.  Our only complaint were the family in the adjoining room that did not control their children at night.  The screaming and banging of furniture in the late night period was terrible.  We believe the parents went to the casino next door leaving the elder child in charge.  It was bad!

reviews.title: Best value and great accommodations
reviews.text: Luv the full kitchen and separate tub. No parking fee too. Best value. Luv being next to southpoint with casino, movie theater, bowling alley. Highly recommend.  Great for families. Don't forget the coupon book too

reviews.title: Christmas vacation
reviews.text: We were greeted by Santa clause when checking in very nice.the casino next door was very convenient as to there was lots of family things to do there movies ,bowling , the buffet had plenty of variety for everyone's taste.

reviews.title: Great location just minutes from the strip
reviews.text: Minutes away from shopping, restaurants and any thing you need for a great vacation to Las Vegas. There is a casino right next door. Units have everything you need. Washer and dryer, bbq grills pools and a great staff.

reviews.title: Grandview
reviews.text: Not to bad other than they couldn't find me a god view. overall I would say good. Everything else is just as they advertise. I can't complain. It's our 2nd time staying there. Its on the south side so its like 10 min from strip

reviews.title: Christmas 2023
reviews.text: The mattresses were wonderful. Everyone in our group enjoyed them. We would definitely stay at this resort again. I’m so glad we gave them a try. The units were split into 1 bedroom apartments with a single common entrance and a separate door to each bedroom. The setup was idea for relatives and friends because of the privacy it allowed.

reviews.title: Lame
reviews.text: We'd stayed at the property previously in 2017, which was a very enjoyable experience. Our return visit in December 2023, however, was vastly different and disappointing. First, both beds were horribly uncomfortable, with the springs sunken and worn out. After complaining, the hotel's solution was to rotate the mattresses, which of course did nothing. Second, our room was scheduled to be cleaned once a week during our stay, but someone came only after we'd called multiple times and waited several days. Third, the heating systems was terribly noisy, making enough racket to wake us up every 20-30 minutes throughout the night.We ended up checking out four days early, eating that cost, and they didn't even inquire as to why we were leaving, so we figured they knew it had been a lousy stay.

reviews.title: National Finals Rodeo
reviews.text: Lovely suites to stay with Friends and Family.  We go every year!  Love the location next to South Point Casino.  Great place to take Children as there are pools, fitness center, barbeque and picnic areas.

reviews.title: Good for what it is
reviews.text: Not super fancy but gets the job done. Lots of room. Washer and dryerIs a huge plus. Elevator was out of service. Other than that no other complaints really. Come here every time we go to Vegas. Always quiet

reviews.title: Prepare to Hunt for Parking Each Night & Hike to Amenities
reviews.text: Returning to resort after 8 pm you might not find a parking spot anywhere near the door to the high rise buildings.    Maintenance carts take up  3-5 spots at each building.  Walking to amenities in cold weather is not inviting. Why not have a scheduled shuttle pickup/dropoff to/from each building from 8 am to 8 pm.?

reviews.title: If I already am an owner, why waste my time and yours by trying to upsell?
reviews.text: I come to my timeshare for a relaxing vacation, not to be hounded and pressured by pushy sales folks.I had friends with me, one who was disabled, and no accommodations were made for her disability.  We couldn't even find handicapped parking 90% of the time and it was hard for her. I specifically wanted to be near the parking structure for that purpose, but was told no.

reviews.title: BOSWELL AKA BOSS
reviews.text: I love this place and its a outstanding experience! I tell people about this place often and always meet good people here. I would love to thank the staff of doing a great job at this resort area and love the Southpoint casino next to the Grandview resort.

reviews.title: Great property and location
reviews.text: We had 2 bedroom unit which is in fact two one bedroom units. So you have alot of room with not only two bedrooms/bathrooms but also two living rooms and kitchens. Dishes, beds and linens were great ....however I did have an one issue. Although counter tops, appliances and bathroom sinks/showers were clean, the cabinets, walls and floors needed a very good cleaning. Lots of water and dirt splashes on walls plus the floor needed vacuuming in the corners, behind and under the doors and furniture plus a deep cleaning of the tiles/grout. Think a light and quick mopping must be the norm....so maybe management should have someone inspecting more closely and regularly the cleanliness of the units.

reviews.title: The Grandview at Las Vegas
reviews.text: The resort is located next door to the Southpoint Casino which makes the location great. Also two minutes from the freeway and new restaurants just across the street. Just 10 minutes from the strip. Only complaint is very few handicap parking, considering many older people visit the resort.

reviews.title: What a welcome
reviews.text: Arriving for a peaceful vacation, only to be greeted by the need to search for towels and toilet paper, was quite disappointing. Upon entering, I found all the cabinets and drawers open, and the bed pulled out, which was not an ideal welcome.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Staying at the Grandview at Las Vegas was beautiful. The rooms are spacious. The views are beautiful. The staff are courteous and professional. My friend and I enjoyed our vacation at the Grandview. We plan to come back soon.

reviews.title: AWESOME PLACE but FILTHY
reviews.text: Appliance did not work, but replaced it Very quickly.Rooms are large ,Did not use any of the facilities but I'm sure were nice.Traveled with another couple so the 2 walk out rooms were wonderful.We traveled for the National Finals Rodeo and it's close to the South Point Casino so it was awesome to be able to walk from there back to our room.

reviews.title: Family stay
reviews.text: We have stayed here at least 6 times. Usually satisfied, great location to SouthPoint Hotel/ Casino. We will stay here again. We did not have all the supplies in the unit this time, but usually well supplied. It had just been a rodeo event next door, very busy.

reviews.title: Fam Xmas 2023
reviews.text: This resort used to be a really good one. We are saddened that the quality has gone south. Some of the appliances do not work. Beddings are missing. Utensils and plates are not properly washed and dirty. The gym needs new equipments. The exercise balls and mats need cleaning or better yet - replaced.

reviews.title: Pleasant GetAway
reviews.text: Great location. Best value for your money.  Spacious suites with all the amenities for a week stay, like having your home away from home.  Responsive staff and well mannered service providers.  Feel very secured staying here.

reviews.title: Wonderful as always except....
reviews.text: Love the Grand View. It is an amazing place. The units are awesome. I love that South Point is next door. The problem? Cleanliness this time. It just needed a deep clean. Spots on the walls, the toilet seat was not clean, counters, light switches, doorknobs. The washer and dryer were gross!  The dust, the blinds were thick with dust. Corners, vents, it needed cleaning! I happened to have Clorox wipes so wiped a lot of things off, but this was the first time we have stayed and it was not super clean!

reviews.title: Get away
reviews.text: Room was not completely cleaned when we arrived. Toilet not cleaned, floors and counters still dirty. Carpets not vacuumed. Units counter top edge broken off, door damaged in bathroom. Carpet in bedroom worn out. Windows very dirty. Was not impressed.Pool staff very rude.

reviews.title: NFR Fun at Grandview
reviews.text: Had another great stay at Grandview during National Finals Rodeo. Have stayed there several times for rodeo. Free shuttle bus to rodeo at Thomas Mack arena. Grandview is located next to South Point which is now the rodeo headquarters. The 2 bedroom units are unique because they are 2 separate 1 bedroom units. This makes it nice when there are two couples. Big thank you to Patrick the night manager. He assisted in getting me to our unit after I had an injury at South Point. Hope the midweek room cleaning will be started again. Only available with stays of 9 nights or longer. Hubby and I had an itchy rash from the sheets. Probably the detergent used. Also bring salt, pepper, and any seasoning if you plan to cook. Still the best place to stay during rodeo.

reviews.title: Annual Stay
reviews.text: As always during the NFR The Grandview is a very busy place. We book our  units and found everything very satifactoey. There was only 1 elevator working in the Sage building, which did cause some delays.

reviews.title: NFR
reviews.text: We go every year to the national rodeo and team roping. The resort has everything you need or want for a vacation you can cook in the room bbq on the grills, kids can swim in the multiple pools and relax in the spas, very safe for the family. It also has a casino in walking distance that hosts different types of things in there arena many are free. They have great restaurants and activities for kids also.

reviews.title: Not Keeping Units Up to Speed
reviews.text: Well, at least this time we didn't spend an hour while the check in counter located our Reservation which seems to be a problem every year..  Our Security Door at Building was broke and open the whole time of our trip So much for Security.... Units are needing work and things always seems to be missing out of units ... IE  Light Bulbs burned out - no extra bedding for pull outs - Carpet is Worn.

reviews.title: Needs a deep clean
reviews.text: I love the Grandview and South point. I was VERY DISAPPOINTED in the cleanliness of the rooms this time at the Grand view. DUST, HAIR, YUCK on the walls.  It is time for some super deep cleaning. I opened the blinds and they were covered in thick dust.  I was glad I had chlorox wipes. I pretty much wiped down everything .  The chlorox wipe was dirty when I was done. GROSS!  Yes, I will return but hopefully some cleaning will take place.

reviews.title: Lovely Resort in Vegas!
reviews.text: This place is an excellent place to stay and keep your peace! Feels and looks like luxury, the casino next door, South Point is one of my favorites! Overall super clean and friendly. The kitchen is my favorite part for when get left with leftovers from restaurants and can save you a ton of money while traveling with friends and family.

reviews.title: The sheets smelt clean
reviews.text: It's rare to go to a hotel and resort, climb in the bed and smell the sheets and they actually smell like soap. It was comforting to know that the sheets were truly clean. Even with rumors of other hotels and their poor practices of not cleaning rooms, properly towels and sheets and blankets etc. Dust was very minimal and everything we needed was available. There was even room service available at this property which is rare for this type of resort. I would definitely recommend and stay here again if in Vegas. Located on the Las Vegas strip but not in the center of it all so it's pretty easy to access the major strip hotels in casinos without having to be in all of the traffic. Plenty of parking if you're renting a car and within 10 minutes of the airport.

reviews.title: SOSO
reviews.text: Unit very uncomfortable. Bring your own pillows they only have small square pillows but a lot of them which does not help.  there is nowhere to really rest the couch is very uncomfortable and no place to put legs up.

reviews.title: family reunion
reviews.text: Great unit layout. Resort proximity to South Point casino restaurants is a benefit (if you can tolerate the smoke in the casino). Floors and shower were not as clean as we would have expected. Great value.

reviews.title: NFR Vacation stay
reviews.text: Great location, right across from Southpoint Casino, access to shuttle service. Easy accessto anywhere..lots of parking..staff at Grandview are extremely friendly and units are clean.  Checking in and out is a breeze...recommend staying short or long term

reviews.title: Great location off Las Vegas strip
reviews.text: PROS…If you don’t want to be in the frenzy of the Las Vegas strip this resort location works.  Love that South Point casino is just next door.  It has shows, restaurants, bowling, movies and rodeo arena. CONS…I have chosen this resort several times, and I’ve always been pleased. However, this time I feel the resort standards have changed. I was disappointed and how tired the furniture looked, it needs an update.  The cleanliness of the room was also disappointing.

reviews.title: Always Enjoy our Stay
reviews.text: We have been enjoying our stay at The Grandview at Las Vegas for many years and hopefully for many years to come. The Casino (South Point) next door is close and there are many amenities. Thanks for all the good memories.
